sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，於青州立太原郡。

translations.literal: On the ting-ch'ou day of the eighth month, T'ai-yüan Commandery was established in Ch'ing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-ch'ou day of the eighth month, T'ai-yüan Commandery was established in Ch'ing Province.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，護軍將軍到彥之卒。

translations.literal: On the hsin-ssu day, Tao Yen-chih, General Who Protects the Army, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-ssu day, Tao Yen-chih, General Who Protects the Army, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，氐楊難當寇漢川。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, the Ti chieftain Yang Nan-t'ang raided Han-ch'uan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, the Di chieftain Yang Nan-t'ang raided Han-ch'uan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，梁州刺史甄法護棄城走，難當據有梁州。

translations.literal: On the ting-wei day, Chen Fa-hu, Governor of Liang Province, abandoned the city and fled; Nan-t'ang seized Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-wei day, Chen Fa-hu, Governor of Liang Province, abandoned the city and fled, and Nan-t'ang took possession of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月，亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山，[13]州郡討平之。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the eleventh year, the outlaw Ma Ta-hsüan and his band of several hundred men raided T'ai-shan; [13] the province and commanderies suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the eleventh year, the outlaw Ma Ta-hsüan and his band of several hundred men raided T'ai-shan; [13] the province and commanderies suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，以交阯太守李耽之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the kuei-yu day of the second month, Li Tan-chih, Administrator of Chiao-chih, was made Governor of Chiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-yu day of the second month, Li Tan-chih, Administrator of Chiao-chih, was appointed Governor of Chiao Province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，梁、秦二州刺史蕭思話破氐楊難當，梁州平。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Hsiao Szu-hua, Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces, defeated the Ti chieftain Yang Nan-t'ang, and Liang Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Hsiao Szu-hua, Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nan-t'ang, and Liang Province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，曲赦梁、南秦二州劍閣北。

translations.literal: On the ting-mao day of the fifth month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the region north of Chien-ko in Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-mao day of the fifth month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the region north of Chien-ko in Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以大沮渠茂虔為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wu-yin day, Chu-chü Mao-ch'ien was made Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wu-yin day, Chu-chü Mao-ch'ien was appointed Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 是月，京邑大水。

translations.literal: That month, the capital suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the capital suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，省魏郡。

translations.literal: On the ting-wei day of the sixth month, Wei Commandery was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-wei day of the sixth month, Wei Commandery was abolished.

sentences.zh: 是歲，林邑國、扶南國、訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, Lin-yi, Fu-nan, and Ho-lo-tan sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Lin-yi, Fu-nan, and Ho-lo-tan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月辛酉，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the hsin-yu day of the first month in spring of the twelfth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-yu day of the first month in spring of the twelfth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On the hsin-wei day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-wei day, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封黃龍國主馮弘為燕王。

translations.literal: On the kuei-yu day, Feng Hung, ruler of the Yellow Dragon state, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yen.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-yu day, Feng Hung, ruler of the Yellow Dragon state, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yen.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，[14]尚書僕射殷景仁加中護軍。

translations.literal: On the i-yu day of the fourth month in summer, [14] Yin Ching-jen, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was additionally made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the i-yu day of the fourth month in summer, [14] Yin Ching-jen, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was additionally appointed General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔曰：「周宗以寧，實由多士，漢室之隆，亦資得人。

translations.literal: On the ping-ch'en day, an edict said: "The house of Chou attained tranquillity through its many officers; the rise of the Han house likewise relied on obtaining men.
translations.idiomatic: On the ping-ch'en day, an edict said: "The Zhou house attained peace through its many officers; the Han dynasty's rise likewise depended on finding the right men.

sentences.zh: 朕寐寤樂賢，為日已久，而則哲難階，明揚莫効。

translations.literal: I have dreamed and waked delighting in the worthy, and this has been so for many days, yet sagely discernment is hard to attain and bright promotion has had no effect.
translations.idiomatic: I have long dreamed and waked with joy in worthy men, yet sage discernment remains hard to reach and bright promotion has borne no fruit.

sentences.zh: 用令遺才在野，管庫虛朝，永懷前載，慚德深矣。

translations.literal: Thus outstanding talent remains in the wilds and the storerooms stand empty at court; eternally recalling former records, my shame in virtue runs deep.
translations.idiomatic: Outstanding talent still wanders beyond office, and the court's storerooms stand empty; thinking forever on the records of old, I am deeply ashamed of my own virtue.

sentences.zh: 夫舉爾所知，宣尼之篤訓，貢士任官，先代之成准。

translations.literal: To raise those whom you know is Confucius's earnest instruction; presenting scholars and assigning office is the established norm of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: To recommend those you know is Confucius's earnest teaching; presenting scholars and appointing them to office is the settled standard of former ages.

sentences.zh: 便可宣敕內外，各有薦舉。

translations.literal: Let an edict be proclaimed within and without, each making recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: Let an edict now be proclaimed within and without, and let each office make recommendations.

sentences.zh: 當依方銓引，以觀厥用。

translations.literal: They shall be selected and promoted according to measure, to observe their employ."
translations.idiomatic: They shall be weighed and advanced by their measure, that we may see what use they can serve."

sentences.zh: 」是夜，京都地震。

translations.literal: That night, the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That night, the capital was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六月，丹陽、淮南、吳興、義興大水，京邑乘船。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Tan-yang, Huai-nan, Wu-hsing, and I-hsing suffered great flooding; in the capital people traveled by boat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Tan-yang, Huai-nan, Wu-hsing, and I-hsing suffered severe flooding, and in the capital people went about by boat.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以徐豫南兗三州、會稽宣城二郡米數百萬斛賜五郡遭水民。

translations.literal: On the chi-yu day, several million hu of grain from Hsü, Yü, and Southern Yen provinces and from the commanderies of K'uai-chi and Hsüan-ch'eng were granted to the people of the five commanderies who had suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-yu day, several million hu of grain from Hsü, Yü, and Southern Yen provinces and from K'uai-chi and Hsüan-ch'eng commanderies were distributed to the people of the five flood-stricken commanderies.

sentences.zh: 是月，斷酒。

translations.literal: That month, the sale of wine was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the sale of wine was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 師子國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The Lion Country sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Lion Country sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，[15]闍婆娑達國、扶南國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the hsin-yu day of the seventh month in autumn, [15] the states of Ch'an-p'o-sa-ta and Fu-nan both sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-yu day of the seventh month in autumn, [15] the states of Ch'an-p'o-sa-ta and Fu-nan both sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，於益州立南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。

translations.literal: On the jen-shên day of the eighth month, the three commanderies of Southern Chin-shou, Southern Hsin-pa, and Northern Pa-hsi were established in Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jen-shên day of the eighth month, the three commanderies of Southern Chin-shou, Southern Hsin-pa, and Northern Pa-hsi were established in Yi Province.

sentences.zh: [16]乙亥，原遭水郡諸逋負。

translations.literal: [16] On the i-hai day, all overdue obligations in the flood-stricken commanderies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: [16] On the i-hai day, all overdue obligations in the flood-stricken commanderies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月，蜀郡賊張尋為寇。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the bandit Chang Hsün of Shu Commandery rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the bandit Chang Hsün of Shu Commandery rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，以右軍行參軍苟道覆為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Ch'ü Tao-fu, Acting Staff Officer of the Right Army, was made Governor of Chiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, Ch'ü Tao-fu, Acting Staff Officer of the Right Army, was appointed Governor of Chiao Province.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月癸丑，上有疾，不朝會。

translations.literal: On the kuei-ch'ou day of the first month in spring of the thirteenth year, the Emperor was ill and did not hold court audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-ch'ou day of the first month in spring of the thirteenth year, the Emperor was ill and did not hold court audience.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，司空、江州刺史檀道濟有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: On the chi-wei day of the third month, Tan Tao-chi, Minister of Works and Governor of Chiang Province, was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-wei day of the third month, Tan Tao-chi, Minister of Works and Governor of Chiang Province, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the keng-shên day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the keng-shên day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 以中軍將軍南譙王義宣為鎮南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: I-hsuan, Prince of Nan-ch'iao and General of the Central Army, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Chiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Nan-ch'iao I-hsuan, General of the Central Army, was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Chiang Province.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊辰，鎮北將軍、徐兗二州刺史王仲德進號鎮北大將軍。

translations.literal: On the wu-ch'en day of the fifth month in summer, Wang Chung-te, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsü and Yen provinces, was advanced in title to Grand General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: On the wu-ch'en day of the fifth month in summer, Wang Chung-te, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsü and Yen provinces, was advanced to Grand General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以征北司馬王方俳為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the keng-ch'en day, Wang Fang-p'ai, Staff Officer of the General Who Campaigns North, was made Governor of Yen Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the keng-ch'en day, Wang Fang-p'ai, Staff Officer of the General Who Campaigns North, was appointed Governor of Yen Province.

sentences.zh: 六月，高麗國、武都王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Kao-li and the Prince of Wu-tu sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Kao-li and the Prince of Wu-tu sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，尚書僕射、中護軍殷景仁改為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the keng-yin day of the eighth month, Yin Ching-jen, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General of the Central Army, was changed to General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the keng-yin day of the eighth month, Yin Ching-jen, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General of the Central Army, was redesignated General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，立第二皇子濬為始興王，第三皇子駿為武陵王。

translations.literal: On the kuei-ch'ou day of the ninth month, the second imperial son Chün was established as Prince of Shih-hsing, and the third imperial son Chün was established as Prince of Wu-ling.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-ch'ou day of the ninth month, the second imperial son Chün was created Prince of Shih-hsing, and the third imperial son Chün was created Prince of Wu-ling.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月辛卯，車駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the hsin-mao day of the first month in spring of the fourteenth year, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-mao day of the first month in spring of the fourteenth year, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 文武賜位一等；

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted one rank of promotion;
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were promoted one rank;

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: the elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: the elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，以步兵校尉劉真道為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jen-tzu day of the second month, Liu Chen-tao, Colonel of Footsoldiers, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the jen-tzu day of the second month, Liu Chen-tao, Colonel of Footsoldiers, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces.

translations.literal: [17] Editorial note seventeen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: [17] Editorial note seventeen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，以輔國將軍周籍之為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On the ting-wei day of the fourth month in summer, Chou Chi-chih, General Who Assists the State, was made Governor of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-wei day of the fourth month in summer, Chou Chi-chih, General Who Assists the State, was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊午，以尚書金部郎中徐森之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wu-wu day of the eighth month in autumn, Hsu Sen-chih, Gentleman of the Gold Section in the Masters of Writing, was made Governor of Chiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wu-wu day of the eighth month in autumn, Hsu Sen-chih, Gentleman of the Gold Section in the Masters of Writing, was appointed Governor of Chiao Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月辛酉，停賀雪。

translations.literal: On the hsin-yu day of the twelfth month in winter, the rite of congratulating on snow was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-yu day of the twelfth month in winter, the rite of congratulating on snow was suspended.

sentences.zh: 河南國、河西王、訶羅單國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The states of Ho-nan, the Prince of the Western River, and Ho-lo-tan all sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The states of Ho-nan, the Prince of the Western River, and Ho-lo-tan all sent envoys bearing tribute.

translations.literal: [18] Editorial note eighteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: [18] Editorial note eighteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 十五年春二月丁未，以平東將軍吐谷渾慕容延為鎮西將軍、秦河二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the ting-wei day of the second month in spring of the fifteenth year, Murong Yen of T'o-yü-hun, General Who Pacifies the East, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Ch'in and Ho provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-wei day of the second month in spring of the fifteenth year, Murong Yen of T'o-yü-hun, General Who Pacifies the East, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Ch'in and Ho provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，燕王弘遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the chia-ch'en day of the fourth month in summer, Prince of Yen Hung sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the chia-ch'en day of the fourth month in summer, Prince of Yen Hung sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: [19]立皇太子妃殷氏，賜王公以下各有差。

translations.literal: [19] The consort of the Heir Apparent, of the Yin clan, was established, and the kings, dukes, and those below were each granted gifts according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: [19] The consort of the Heir Apparent of the Yin clan was installed, and kings, dukes, and officials below them were each granted gifts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以倭國王珍為安東將軍。

translations.literal: On the chi-ssu day, Chen, King of Wa, was made General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-ssu day, Chen, King of Wa, was appointed General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，特進、右光祿大夫殷穆卒。

translations.literal: On the chi-ch'ou day, Yin Mu, Special Grandee and Right Grandee of Splendid Virtue, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-ch'ou day, Yin Mu, Special Grandee and Right Grandee of Splendid Virtue, died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鎮北大將軍、徐州刺史王仲德卒。

translations.literal: On the hsin-mao day, Wang Chung-te, Grand General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsü Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-mao day, Wang Chung-te, Grand General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsü Province, died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以右衞將軍劉遵考為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jen-ch'en day, Liu Tsun-k'ao, General of the Right Guards, was made Governor of Hsü and Yen provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the jen-ch'en day, Liu Tsun-k'ao, General of the Right Guards, was appointed Governor of Hsü and Yen provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，地震。

translations.literal: On the hsin-wei day of the seventh month in autumn, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-wei day of the seventh month in autumn, there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以陳、南頓二郡太守徐循為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On the chia-hsü day, Hsu Hsün, Administrator of Ch'en and Nan-tun, was made Governor of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the chia-hsü day, Hsu Hsün, Administrator of Ch'en and Nan-tun, was appointed Governor of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，以左衞將軍趙伯符為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the hsin-ch'ou day of the eighth month, Chao Po-fu, General of the Left Guards, was made Governor of Hsü and Yen provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-ch'ou day of the eighth month, Chao Po-fu, General of the Left Guards, was appointed Governor of Hsü and Yen provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以始興內史陸徽為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the chia-yin day, Lu Hui, Administrator of Shih-hsing, was made Governor of Kuang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the chia-yin day, Lu Hui, Administrator of Shih-hsing, was appointed Governor of Kuang Province.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以兗州刺史王方俳為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the ting-ssu day, Wang Fang-p'ai, Governor of Yen Province, was made Governor of Ch'ing and Chi provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-ssu day, Wang Fang-p'ai, Governor of Yen Province, was appointed Governor of Ch'ing and Chi provinces.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南國、高麗國、倭國、扶南國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, the Prince of Wu-tu, the state of Ho-nan, Kao-li, Wa, Fu-nan, and Lin-yi all sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the Prince of Wu-tu, the state of Ho-nan, Kao-li, Wa, Fu-nan, and Lin-yi all sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月戊寅，車駕於北郊閱武。

translations.literal: On the wu-yin day of the first month in spring of the sixteenth year, the imperial carriage reviewed troops at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the wu-yin day of the first month in spring of the sixteenth year, the Emperor reviewed troops at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史彭城王義康進位大將軍，領司徒，餘如故。

translations.literal: On the keng-yin day, I-k'ang, Prince of P'eng-ch'eng, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was advanced in rank to Grand General; he continued as Minister over the Masses, and the rest of his offices remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the keng-yin day, Prince of P'eng-ch'eng I-k'ang, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was advanced to Grand General; he remained Minister over the Masses, and his other offices were unchanged.

sentences.zh: 征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭進位司空，刺史如故。

translations.literal: I-chung, Prince of Chiang-hsia, General Who Campaigns North, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Southern Yen Province, was advanced in rank to Minister of Works; his governorship remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Chiang-hsia I-chung, General Who Campaigns North, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Southern Yen Province, was advanced to Minister of Works; his governorship was unchanged.

sentences.zh: 特進、左光祿大夫王敬弘開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Wang Ching-hung, Special Grandee and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, was given the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ching-hung, Special Grandee and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, received the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，復分荊州置湘州。

translations.literal: On the kuei-ssu day, Ching Province was again divided to establish Hsiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-ssu day, Ching Province was again divided to establish Hsiang Province.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，以南徐州刺史衡陽王義季為安西將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On the chi-hai day of the second month, I-chi, Prince of Heng-yang and Governor of Southern Hsü Province, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Ching Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-hai day of the second month, Prince of Heng-yang I-chi, Governor of Southern Hsü Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Ching Province.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以始興王濬為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the ting-wei day, Chün, Prince of Shih-hsing, was made Governor of Hsiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-wei day, Prince of Shih-hsing Chün was appointed Governor of Hsiang Province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，割梁州之巴西梓潼南宕渠南漢中、南秦州之南安懷寧凡六郡，[20]屬益州。

translations.literal: On the kuei-hai day, the six commanderies of Pa-hsi, Tzu-t'ung, Southern Tang-ch'ü, Southern Han-chung from Liang Province and Nan-an and Huai-ning from Southern Ch'in Province were severed [20] and placed under Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-hai day, the six commanderies of Pa-hsi, Tzu-t'ung, Southern Tang-ch'ü, Southern Han-chung from Liang Province and Nan-an and Huai-ning from Southern Ch'in Province were detached [20] and assigned to Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 分長沙江夏郡立巴陵郡，屬湘州。

translations.literal: Pa-ling Commandery was established from the commanderies of Ch'ang-sha and Chiang-hsia and placed under Hsiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Pa-ling Commandery was carved out of Ch'ang-sha and Chiang-hsia commanderies and placed under Hsiang Province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，以鎮南將軍、江州刺史南譙王義宣為征北將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the ting-ssu day of the fourth month in summer, I-hsuan, Prince of Nan-ch'iao, General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Chiang Province, was made General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Hsü Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-ssu day of the fourth month in summer, Prince of Nan-ch'iao I-hsuan, General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Chiang Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Hsü Province.

sentences.zh: 平西將軍臨川王義慶為衞將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: I-ch'ing, Prince of Lin-ch'uan and General Who Pacifies the West, was made General of the Guard and Governor of Chiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Lin-ch'uan I-ch'ing, General Who Pacifies the West, was appointed General of the Guard and Governor of Chiang Province.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，隴西吐谷渾慕容延改封河南王。

translations.literal: On the chi-yu day of the sixth month, Murong Yen of Lung-hsi T'o-yü-hun was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Ho-nan.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-yu day of the sixth month, Murong Yen of Lung-hsi T'o-yü-hun was redesignated Prince of Ho-nan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以吐谷渾拾寅為平西將軍，吐谷渾繁暱為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the kuei-ch'ou day, Shih-pin of T'o-yü-hun was made General Who Pacifies the West, and Fan-ni of T'o-yü-hun was made General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-ch'ou day, Shih-pin of T'o-yü-hun was appointed General Who Pacifies the West, and Fan-ni of T'o-yü-hun was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚子，立第四皇子鑠為南平王。

translations.literal: On the keng-tzu day of the eighth month in autumn, the fourth imperial son Shuo was established as Prince of Nan-p'ing.
translations.idiomatic: On the keng-tzu day of the eighth month in autumn, the fourth imperial son Shuo was created Prince of Nan-p'ing.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙未，鎮軍將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣薨。

translations.literal: On the i-wei day of the intercalary month, I-hsin, Prince of Ch'ang-sha, General of the Army and Governor of Yü Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the i-wei day of the intercalary month, Prince of Ch'ang-sha I-hsin, General of the Army and Governor of Yü Province, died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，復分豫州之淮南為南豫州。

translations.literal: On the wu-hsü day, Huai-nan from Yü Province was again divided to establish Southern Yü Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wu-hsü day, Huai-nan was again severed from Yü Province to establish Southern Yü Province.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以左衞將軍劉遵考為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the kuei-mao day, Liu Tsun-k'ao, General of the Left Guards, was made Governor of Yü Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-mao day, Liu Tsun-k'ao, General of the Left Guards, was appointed Governor of Yü Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以湘州刺史始興王濬為南豫州刺史，武陵王駿為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wu-shên day, Chün, Prince of Shih-hsing and Governor of Hsiang Province, was made Governor of Southern Yü Province, and Chün, Prince of Wu-ling, was made Governor of Hsiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wu-shên day, Prince of Shih-hsing Chün, Governor of Hsiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yü Province, and Prince of Wu-ling Chün became Governor of Hsiang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月乙亥，皇太子冠，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the i-hai day of the twelfth month in winter, the Heir Apparent underwent the capping ceremony, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the i-hai day of the twelfth month in winter, the Heir Apparent underwent the capping ceremony, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南王、林邑國、高麗國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, the Prince of Wu-tu, the Prince of Ho-nan, Lin-yi, and Kao-li sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the Prince of Wu-tu, the Prince of Ho-nan, Lin-yi, and Kao-li sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十七年夏四月戊午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the wu-wu day, the first of the fourth month in summer of the seventeenth year, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the wu-wu day, the first of the fourth month in summer of the seventeenth year, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，領軍將軍劉湛母憂去職。

translations.literal: On the kuei-ssu day of the fifth month, Liu Chan, General of the Army of the Palace Guard, left office on his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-ssu day of the fifth month, Liu Chan, General of the Army of the Palace Guard, left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，以征虜諮議參軍杜驥為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the seventh month in autumn, Du Ji, Consulting Colonel of General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was made Governor of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the seventh month in autumn, Du Ji, Consulting Colonel of General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 壬子，皇后袁氏崩。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, Empress Yuan of the Yuan clan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Empress Yuan of the Yuan clan died.

sentences.zh: 八月，徐、兗、青、冀四州大水，己未，遣使檢行賑卹。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered great flooding; on the jiwei day, envoys were sent to inspect the districts and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered severe flooding; on the jiwei day, envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，葬元皇后於長寧陵。

translations.literal: On the renzi day of the ninth month, the Primary Empress was buried at Changning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the ninth month, the Primary Empress was buried at Changning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，前丹陽尹劉湛有罪，及同黨伏誅。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the tenth month in winter, Liu Zhan, former Governor of Danyang, was guilty; he and his accomplices were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the tenth month in winter, Liu Zhan, former Governor of Danyang, was found guilty; he and his accomplices were executed.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，文武賜爵一級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were raised one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 以大將軍、領司徒、錄尚書、揚州刺史彭城王義康為江州刺史，大將軍如故。

translations.literal: Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand General, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was made Governor of Jiang Province; his title as Grand General remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand General, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province; his title as Grand General was unchanged.

sentences.zh: 以司空、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為司徒、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister of Works and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister of Works and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，衞將軍臨川王義慶以本號為南兗州刺史，尚書僕射、護軍將軍殷景仁為揚州刺史，僕射如故。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, was made Governor of Southern Yan Province with his former title; Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was made Governor of Yang Province; his vice directorship remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province while retaining his former title; Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was appointed Governor of Yang Province; his vice directorship was unchanged.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，以尚書劉義融為領軍將軍，祕書監徐湛之為中護軍。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the eleventh month, Liu Yirong of the Masters of Writing was made General Who Leads the Army; Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the eleventh month, Liu Yirong of the Masters of Writing was appointed General Who Leads the Army; Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「前所給揚、南徐二州百姓田糧種子，兗、兩豫、青、徐諸州比年所寬租穀應督入者，悉除半。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, an edict said: "The field grain and seed previously granted to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, and the rent grain from Yan, both Yu, Qing, and Xu provinces that in recent years was remitted and should have been collected and forwarded—all are reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, an edict said: "The field grain and seed previously granted to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, and the rent grain from Yan, both Yu, Qing, and Xu provinces that in recent years was remitted and should have been collected and forwarded—all are reduced by half.

sentences.zh: 今年有不收處，[21]都原之。

translations.literal: Where there was no harvest this year, [21] all is remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Where there was no harvest this year, [21] all obligations are remitted.

sentences.zh: 凡諸逋債，優量申減。

translations.literal: All overdue debts are to be generously assessed and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: All overdue debts are to be generously assessed and reduced.

sentences.zh: 又州郡估稅，所在市調，多有煩刻。

translations.literal: Moreover, the appraisal taxes of the provinces and commanderies and the market levies wherever imposed are in many places burdensome and harsh.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the appraisal taxes of the provinces and commanderies and the market levies imposed locally are in many places burdensome and harsh.

sentences.zh: 山澤之利，猶或禁斷；

translations.literal: The profits of mountains and marshes are still in some places forbidden and cut off;
translations.idiomatic: The profits of mountains and marshes are still in some places forbidden and cut off;

sentences.zh: 役召之品，遂及稚弱。

translations.literal: the categories of corvée summons extend even to the young and weak.
translations.idiomatic: the categories of corvée summons extend even to the young and weak.

sentences.zh: 諸如此比，傷治害民。

translations.literal: Matters such as these injure governance and harm the people.
translations.idiomatic: Matters such as these injure governance and harm the people.

sentences.zh: 自今咸依法令，務盡優允。

translations.literal: From now on all are to follow the laws and ordinances and strive to grant full favor and allowance.
translations.idiomatic: From now on all are to follow the laws and ordinances and strive to grant full favor and allowance.

sentences.zh: 如有不便，即依事別言，不得苟趣一時，以乖隱卹之旨。

translations.literal: If anything is inconvenient, report it separately according to the matter; do not hastily pursue momentary gain and thereby violate the intent of hidden compassion.
translations.idiomatic: If anything is inconvenient, report it separately according to the matter; do not hastily pursue momentary gain and thereby violate the intent of hidden compassion.

sentences.zh: 主者明加宣下，稱朕意焉。

translations.literal: Those in charge are clearly to proclaim this below and make known my intent."
translations.idiomatic: Those in charge are clearly to proclaim this below and make known my intent."

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，尚書僕射、揚州刺史殷景仁卒。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Wang Qiu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Wang Qiu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: [22]戊辰，以南豫州刺史始興王濬為揚州刺史，湘州刺史武陵王駿為南豫州刺史，南平王鑠為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: [22] On the wuchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was made Governor of Yang Province; Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xiang Province, was made Governor of Southern Yu Province; and Prince of Nanping Shuo was made Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: [22] On the wuchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yang Province; Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xiang Province, became Governor of Southern Yu Province; and Prince of Nanping Shuo was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南王、百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, the Prince of Wudu, the Prince of Henan, and Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the Prince of Wudu, the Prince of Henan, and Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十八年春二月乙卯，以豫章太守庾登之為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the second month in spring of the eighteenth year, Yu Dengzhi, Administrator of Zhang Commandery, was made Governor of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the second month in spring of the eighteenth year, Yu Dengzhi, Administrator of Zhang Commandery, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午，[23]衞將軍南兗州刺史臨川王義慶、征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the fifth month in summer, [23] Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard and Governor of Southern Yan Province, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, were both given the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the fifth month in summer, [23] Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard and Governor of Southern Yan Province, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, were both granted the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，於交州置宋熙郡。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, the commandery of Songxi was established in Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the commandery of Songxi was established in Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 是月，沔水泛溢。

translations.literal: That month, the Han River overflowed its banks.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Han River overflowed its banks.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，遣使巡行賑贍。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the sixth month, envoys were sent to tour the districts and provide relief and sustenance.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the sixth month, envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，領軍將軍劉義融卒。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Liu Yirong, General Who Leads the Army, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Liu Yirong, General Who Leads the Army, died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，以徐、兗二州刺史趙伯符為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day of the seventh month in autumn, Zhao Bofu, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was made General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the seventh month in autumn, Zhao Bofu, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，以巴東、建平二郡太守臧質為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the tenth month in winter, Zang Zhi, Administrator of Badong and Jianping commanderies, was made Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the tenth month in winter, Zang Zhi, Administrator of Badong and Jianping commanderies, was appointed Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，省南徐州之南燕、濮陽、南廣平郡。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，尚書僕射王球卒。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, Wang Qiu, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, Wang Qiu, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.

sentences.zh: [24]己亥，以丹陽尹孟顗為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: [24] On the jihai day, Meng Yan, Governor of Danyang, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: [24] On the jihai day, Meng Yan, Governor of Danyang, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 氐楊難當又寇漢川。

translations.literal: The Di chieftain Yang Nandang again raided Han-chuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Di chieftain Yang Nandang again raided Han-chuan.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，遣龍驤將軍裴方明與梁、秦二州刺史劉真道討之。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, and Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, were dispatched to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, and Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, were dispatched to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 是月，[25]晉寧太守爨松子反叛，寧州刺史徐循討平之。

translations.literal: That month, [25] Cuan Songzi, Administrator of Jinning, rebelled; Xu Xun, Governor of Ning Province, suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: That month, [25] Cuan Songzi, Administrator of Jinning, rebelled; Xu Xun, Governor of Ning Province, defeated and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，肅特國、高麗國、蘇靡黎國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, Suote, Koguryo, Sumili, and Lin-yi all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Suote, Koguryo, Sumili, and Lin-yi all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十九年正月乙巳，詔曰：「夫所因者本，聖哲之遠教；

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the first month in spring of the nineteenth year, an edict said: "What one relies upon is the root; this is the far-reaching teaching of the sage and wise.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the first month in spring of the nineteenth year, an edict said: "What one relies upon is the root; this is the far-reaching teaching of the sage and wise.

sentences.zh: 本立化成，斆學之為貴。

translations.literal: When the root is established, transformation is formed; instruction and learning are held precious.
translations.idiomatic: When the root is established, transformation takes shape; instruction and learning are held precious.

sentences.zh: 故詔以三德，崇以四術，用能納諸義方，致之軌度。

translations.literal: Therefore one is admonished with the three virtues and honored with the four arts, thereby able to receive all into the path of righteousness and bring them to measure and standard.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore one is admonished with the three virtues and honored with the four arts, thereby able to receive all into the path of righteousness and bring them to measure and standard.

sentences.zh: 盛王聖世，[26]咸必由之。

translations.literal: In flourishing kingship and sagely ages, [26] all necessarily proceed by this.
translations.idiomatic: In flourishing kingship and sagely ages, [26] all necessarily proceed by this.

sentences.zh: 永初受命，憲章弘遠，將陶鈞庶品，混一殊風，有詔典司，大啟庠序，而頻遘屯夷，未及修建。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongchu the mandate was received and the statutes and regulations were broadly extended, intending to shape the myriad classes and unify diverse customs; there was an edict to the responsible offices to open the schools on a great scale, yet repeatedly encountering repeated adversity, construction was not completed in time.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongchu the mandate was received and the statutes and regulations were broadly extended, intending to shape the myriad classes and unify diverse customs; there was an edict to the responsible offices to open the schools on a great scale, yet repeatedly encountering repeated adversity, construction was not completed in time.

sentences.zh: 永瞻前猷，思敷鴻烈。

translations.literal: Eternally gazing upon the former plan, I think to spread the great achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Eternally gazing upon the former plan, I think to spread the great achievement.

sentences.zh: 今方隅乂寧，戎夏慕嚮，廣訓冑子，實維時務。

translations.literal: Now the regions are at peace and the barbarians and Chinese alike turn in admiration; broadly to instruct the sons of the state is truly the task of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Now the regions are at peace and the barbarians and Chinese alike turn in admiration; broadly to instruct the sons of the state is truly the task of the age.

sentences.zh: 便可式遵成規，闡揚景業。」

translations.literal: Let the established regulations now be followed and the splendid enterprise proclaimed."
translations.idiomatic: Let the established regulations now be followed and the splendid enterprise proclaimed."

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，以久疾愈，始奉礿祠，[27]大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the fourth month in summer, because a long illness had healed, for the first time the yue sacrifice was performed; [27] a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the fourth month in summer, because a long illness had healed, the yue sacrifice was performed for the first time; [27] a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，梁秦二州刺史劉真道、龍驤將軍裴方明破氐楊難當，仇池平。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day of the fifth month, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, and Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nandang; Chouchi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the fifth month, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, and Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nandang; Chouchi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 閏月，京邑雨水；

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, the capital suffered rain and flooding;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, the capital suffered rain and flooding;

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣使巡行賑卹。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, envoys were sent to tour the districts and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，以大沮渠無諱為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was made Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was appointed Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以梁、秦二州刺史劉真道為雍州刺史，龍驤將軍裴方明為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month in autumn, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, was made Governor of Yong Province; Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month in autumn, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, was appointed Governor of Yong Province; Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲戌晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month, jiaxu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the month, jiaxu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day of the tenth month in winter, Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the tenth month in winter, Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以晉寧太守周萬歲為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, Zhou Wansui, Administrator of Jinning, was made Governor of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Zhou Wansui, Administrator of Jinning, was appointed Governor of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，詔曰：「冑子始集，學業方興。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day of the twelfth month, an edict said: "The sons of the state are beginning to gather and studies are just rising.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the twelfth month, an edict said: "The sons of the state are beginning to gather and studies are just rising.

sentences.zh: 自微言泯絕，逝將千祀，感事思人，意有慨然。

translations.literal: Since subtle teachings were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; moved by events I think of those men, and my feelings are stirred with emotion.
translations.idiomatic: Since subtle teachings were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; moved by events I think of those men, and my feelings are stirred with emotion.

sentences.zh: 奉聖之胤，可速議繼襲。

translations.literal: The descendants of the Sage of Veneration may speedily deliberate succession.
translations.idiomatic: The descendants of the Sage of Veneration may speedily deliberate succession.

sentences.zh: 於先廟地，特為營造，依舊給祠置令，四時饗祀。

translations.literal: On the site of the former temple, a special structure is to be built; according to the old practice, an official for sacrifices is to be appointed, with offerings in the four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: On the site of the former temple, a special structure is to be built; according to the old practice, an official for sacrifices is to be appointed, with offerings in the four seasons.

sentences.zh: 闕里往經寇亂，黌校殘毀，并下魯郡修復學舍，採召生徒。

translations.literal: Que-li in the past suffered bandit turmoil and the school buildings were ruined; orders are also sent down to Lu Commandery to repair the school quarters and recruit students.
translations.idiomatic: Que-li in the past suffered bandit turmoil and the school buildings were ruined; orders are also sent down to Lu Commandery to repair the school quarters and recruit students.

sentences.zh: 昔之賢哲及一介之善，猶或衞其丘壟，禁其芻牧，況尼父德表生民，功被百代，而墳塋荒蕪，荊棘弗翦。

translations.literal: Former worthy men and sages, and even a single act of goodness, still perhaps guarded their hill mounds and forbade grazing and cutting; how much more does the Teacher whose virtue marks all the living and whose merit covers a hundred generations have his tomb mound overgrown and brambles uncut.
translations.idiomatic: Former worthy men and sages, and even a single act of goodness, still perhaps guarded their hill mounds and forbade grazing and cutting; how much more does the Teacher whose virtue marks all the living and whose merit covers a hundred generations have his tomb mound overgrown and brambles uncut.

sentences.zh: 可蠲墓側數戶，以掌洒掃。

translations.literal: Several households beside the tomb may be exempted from levies to attend to sweeping and sprinkling.
translations.idiomatic: Several households beside the tomb may be exempted from levies to attend to sweeping and sprinkling.

sentences.zh: 」魯郡上民孔景等五戶居近孔子墓側，蠲其課役，供給洒掃，并種松栢六百株。

translations.literal: " The leading commoners of Lu Commandery, Kong Jing and four other households, dwelling near Confucius's tomb, were exempted from their tax and corvée duties, supplied for sweeping and sprinkling, and six hundred pine and cypress trees were additionally planted.
translations.idiomatic: The leading commoners of Lu Commandery, Kong Jing and four other households, dwelling near Confucius's tomb, were exempted from their tax and corvée duties, supplied for sweeping and sprinkling, and six hundred pine and cypress trees were additionally planted.

sentences.zh: 是歲，婆皇國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, the state of Bapo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Bapo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月，於臺城東西開萬春、千秋二門。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, at the east and west of Terrace City the Wanchun and Qianqiu gates were opened.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, at the east and west of Terrace City the Wanchun and Qianqiu gates were opened.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，江州刺史庾登之為中護軍。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the second month, Yu Dengzhi, Governor of Jiang Province, was made Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the second month, Yu Dengzhi, Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 庚申，[28]以廬陵王紹為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, [28] Prince of Luling Shao was made Governor of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, [28] Prince of Luling Shao was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 仇池為索虜所沒。

translations.literal: Chouchi was overrun by the Suolu.
translations.idiomatic: Chouchi was overrun by the Suolu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，車駕於白下閱武。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, the imperial carriage reviewed troops at Baixia.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the Emperor reviewed troops at Baixia.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，安西將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季進號征西大將軍。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced in title to Grand General Who Campaigns West.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to Grand General Who Campaigns West.

sentences.zh: 以巴西、梓潼二郡太守申坦為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: Shen Tan, Administrator of Baxi and Zitong commanderies, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Tan, Administrator of Baxi and Zitong commanderies, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，立第六皇子誕為廣陵王。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the fourth month in summer, the sixth imperial son Dan was established as Prince of Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fourth month in summer, the sixth imperial son Dan was created Prince of Guangling.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，中護軍庾登之卒。

translations.literal: On the guichou day of the fifth month, Yu Dengzhi, Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the fifth month, Yu Dengzhi, Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，以楊文德為征西將軍、北秦州刺史，封武都王。

translations.literal: On the guichou day of the seventh month in autumn, Yang Wende was made General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the seventh month in autumn, Yang Wende was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以南蠻校尉蕭思話為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, Xiao Sihua, Colonel of the Southern Man, was made Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Xiao Sihua, Colonel of the Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 甲子，前雍州刺史劉真道、梁南秦二州刺史裴方明有罪，下獄死。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, Liu Zhendao, former Governor of Yong Province, and Pei Fangming, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, were guilty; they were imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Liu Zhendao, former Governor of Yong Province, and Pei Fangming, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, were found guilty; they were imprisoned and executed.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，以廷尉陶愍祖為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day of the eighth month, Tao Minzu, Director of Punishments, was made Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the eighth month, Tao Minzu, Director of Punishments, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月庚午，以始興內史檀和之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month in winter, Tan Hezhi, Administrator of Shixing, was made Governor of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month in winter, Tan Hezhi, Administrator of Shixing, was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔曰：「國以民為本，民以食為天。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its root; the people take food as their heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its root; the people take food as their heaven.

sentences.zh: 故一夫輟稼，饑者必及。

translations.literal: Therefore if one man ceases sowing, hunger necessarily reaches others.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore if one man ceases sowing, hunger necessarily reaches others.

sentences.zh: 倉廩既實，禮節以興。

translations.literal: When the granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise.
translations.idiomatic: When the granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise.

sentences.zh: 自頃在所貧罄，家無宿積。

translations.literal: Recently wherever one looks there is destitution; households have no stores overnight.
translations.idiomatic: Recently wherever one looks there is destitution; households have no stores overnight.

sentences.zh: 賦役暫偏，則人懷愁墊；

translations.literal: When levies and corvée are for a time uneven, then the people harbor anxious distress;
translations.idiomatic: When levies and corvée are for a time uneven, then the people harbor anxious distress;

sentences.zh: 歲或不稔，而病乏比室。

translations.literal: when the year is sometimes not abundant, sickness and want visit house after house.
translations.idiomatic: when the year is sometimes not abundant, sickness and want visit house after house.

sentences.zh: 誠由政德弗孚，以臻斯弊；

translations.literal: Truly this is because governmental virtue has not won trust, thereby bringing these ills;
translations.idiomatic: Truly this is because governmental virtue has not won trust, thereby bringing these ills;

sentences.zh: 抑亦耕桑未廣，地利多遺。

translations.literal: yet also farming and sericulture are not widely extended, and the land's profit is much left unused.
translations.idiomatic: yet also farming and sericulture are not widely extended, and the land's profit is much left unused.

sentences.zh: 宰守微化導之方，萌庶忘勤分之義。

translations.literal: Magistrates and prefects are slight in the methods of transforming and guiding; the common folk forget the meaning of diligent division of labor.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates and prefects are slight in the methods of transforming and guiding; the common folk forget the meaning of diligent division of labor.

sentences.zh: 永言弘濟，明發載懷。

translations.literal: Speaking forever of broad relief, at dawn my thoughts are laden.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking forever of broad relief, at dawn my thoughts are laden.

sentences.zh: 雖制令亟下，終莫懲勸，而坐望滋殖，庸可致乎。

translations.literal: Although regulations and orders are repeatedly issued, in the end none are warned and encouraged, yet sitting and looking for increase and growth—how can that be attained?
translations.idiomatic: Although regulations and orders are repeatedly issued, in the end none are warned and encouraged, yet sitting and looking for increase and growth—how can that be attained?

sentences.zh: 有司其班宣舊條，務盡敦課。

translations.literal: The responsible offices are to proclaim the old articles and strive to fulfill earnest instruction.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices are to proclaim the old articles and strive to fulfill earnest instruction.

sentences.zh: 遊食之徒，咸令附業，考覈勤惰，行其誅賞，觀察能殿，嚴加黜陟。

translations.literal: Wandering idlers are all to be ordered to attach to occupations; diligence and sloth are to be examined and verified, and punishments and rewards applied; ability and conduct are to be observed, and demotion and promotion strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Wandering idlers are all to be ordered to attach to occupations; diligence and sloth are to be examined and verified, and punishments and rewards applied; ability and conduct are to be observed, and demotion and promotion strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 古者躬耕帝籍，敬供粢盛，仰瞻前王，思遵令典。

translations.literal: In antiquity the ruler personally plowed the imperial fields and respectfully supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, I think to follow the established canon.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the ruler personally plowed the imperial fields and respectfully supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, I think to follow the established canon.

sentences.zh: 便可量處千畝，考卜元辰。

translations.literal: Let a thousand mu be measured out and the primary day divined.
translations.idiomatic: Let a thousand mu be measured out and the primary day divined.

sentences.zh: 朕當親率百辟，致禮郊甸，庶幾誠素，將被斯民。」

translations.literal: I shall personally lead the hundred officials and perform rites in the suburban fields, that sincerity and plainness may reach this people."
translations.idiomatic: I shall personally lead the hundred officials and perform rites in the suburban fields, that sincerity and plainness may reach this people."

sentences.zh: 是歲，河西國、高麗國、百濟國、倭國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, Hexi, Koguryo, Baekje, and Wa all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Hexi, Koguryo, Baekje, and Wa all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸州郡水旱傷稼，民大饑。

translations.literal: That year, in the various provinces and commanderies flood and drought injured the crops, and the people suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the various provinces and commanderies flood and drought injured the crops, and the people suffered great famine.

sentences.zh: 遣使開倉賑卹，給賜糧種。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to open the granaries for relief, and grain and seed were granted and bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to open the granaries for relief, and grain and seed were granted and distributed.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月己亥，南徐、南豫州、揚州之浙江西，[29]並禁酒。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the first month in spring of the twenty-first year, Southern Xu, Southern Yu Province, and the districts of Yang Province west of the Zhe River [29] all prohibited wine.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month in spring of the twenty-first year, Southern Xu, Southern Yu Province, and the districts of Yang Province west of the Zhe River [29] all prohibited wine.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 諸逋債在十九年以前，一切原除。

translations.literal: All overdue debts from before the nineteenth year were completely remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All overdue debts dating from before the nineteenth year were completely remitted.

sentences.zh: 去歲失收者，疇量申減。

translations.literal: Where harvest failed last year, reductions were to be assessed and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Where the harvest had failed the previous year, reductions were to be assessed and reported.

sentences.zh: 尤弊之處，遣使就郡縣隨宜賑卹。

translations.literal: In especially distressed places, envoys were sent to the commanderies and counties for relief as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: In the most distressed districts, envoys were dispatched to the commanderies and counties to provide relief as local conditions required.

sentences.zh: 凡欲附農，而種糧匱乏者，並加給貸。

translations.literal: All who wished to attach themselves to farming but lacked seed grain were additionally given loans.
translations.idiomatic: All who wished to return to farming but lacked seed grain were additionally granted loans.

sentences.zh: 營千畝諸統司役人，賜布各有差。

translations.literal: Those engaged in establishing the thousand-mu fields and the corvée workers of the various supervising offices were granted cloth, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée workers in the offices overseeing the thousand-mu fields were granted cloth, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 戊午，衞將軍臨川王義慶薨。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan and General of the Guard, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以太子詹事劉義宗為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, Liu Yizong, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Liu Yizong, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，以領軍將軍趙伯符為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the second month, Zhao Bofu, General Who Leads the Army, was made Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the second month, Zhao Bofu, General Who Leads the Army, was appointed Governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 己丑，司徒、錄尚書事江夏王義恭進位太尉，領司徒。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, was advanced to Grand Commandant and continued as Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, was promoted to Grand Commandant while retaining the post of Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以右衞將軍沈演之為中領軍。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Shen Yanzhi, General of the Right Guards, was made Director of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Shen Yanzhi, General of the Right Guards, was appointed Director of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，立第七皇子宏為建平王。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, the seventh imperial son Hong was established as Prince of Jianping.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the seventh imperial son Hong was created Prince of Jianping.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以廣陵王誕為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, Dan, Prince of Guangling, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Prince of Guangling Dan was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，晉陵延陵民徐耕以米千斛助卹饑民。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling contributed a thousand hu of grain to aid famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling contributed a thousand hu of grain to relieve the famine-stricken.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，以尚書何尚之為中護軍，諮議參軍劉道錫為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renxu day of the fifth month, He Shangzhi, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made General of the Central Army; Liu Daoxi, Consulting Colonel, was made Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the fifth month, He Shangzhi, Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed General of the Central Army; Liu Daoxi, Consulting Colonel, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 六月，連雨水。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, rain fell continuously.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, rain fell without cease.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「霖雨彌日，水潦為患，百姓積儉，易致乏匱。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, an edict said: "Rain has fallen day after day; flooding has become a disaster, and the people, having grown spare in their stores, easily fall into want.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, an edict said: "Rain has fallen day after day; flooding has become a disaster, and the people, their stores grown spare, easily fall into want.

sentences.zh: 二縣官長及營署部司，各隨統檢實，給其柴米，必使周悉。」

translations.literal: The chief officials of the two counties and the departmental offices of the garrisons shall each, according to their jurisdiction, inspect and verify and supply firewood and grain, ensuring that provision is complete."
translations.idiomatic: The chief officials of the two counties and the departmental offices of the garrisons shall each, within their jurisdiction, inspect and verify accounts and supply firewood and grain, ensuring that nothing is left wanting."

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，揚州刺史始興王濬加中軍將軍，南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day of the seventh month in autumn, Jun, Prince of Shixing and Governor of Yang Province, was additionally made General of the Central Army; Jun, Prince of Wuling and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the seventh month in autumn, Prince of Shixing Jun, Governor of Yang Province, was additionally appointed General of the Central Army; Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: [30]乙巳，詔曰：「比年穀稼傷損，淫亢成災，亦由播殖之宜，尚有未盡。

translations.literal: [30] On the yisi day, an edict said: "In recent years grain crops have been injured and excessive rain has become a calamity—this is also because the proper seasons for planting have not yet been fully observed.
translations.idiomatic: [30] On the yisi day, an edict said: "In recent years the grain harvest has suffered injury and excessive rain has brought calamity—this is also because the proper seasons for planting have not yet been fully observed.

sentences.zh: 南徐、兗、豫及揚州浙江西屬郡，自今悉督種麥，以助闕乏。

translations.literal: In the commanderies subordinate to Southern Xu, Yan, Yu, and the western districts of Yang Province beyond the Zhe River, from now on all are to be directed to plant wheat to help supply what is lacking.
translations.idiomatic: In Southern Xu, Yan, Yu, and the western districts of Yang Province beyond the Zhe River, all are henceforth to be directed to plant wheat to help make up what is lacking.

sentences.zh: 速運彭城下邳郡見種，委刺史貸給。

translations.literal: Seed now available in Pengcheng and Xiapi commanderies is to be transported quickly and entrusted to the inspectors for loan and distribution.
translations.idiomatic: Seed now available in Pengcheng and Xiapi commanderies is to be transported at once and entrusted to the inspectors for loan and distribution.

sentences.zh: 徐、豫土多稻田，而民間專務陸作，可符二鎮，履行舊陂，相率修立，并課墾闢，使及來年。

translations.literal: The soil of Xu and Yu has many paddy fields, yet among the people dry cultivation alone is pursued; orders may be sent to the two garrisons to put old embankments back in use, jointly repair and establish them, and also assign reclamation so that this is achieved by next year.
translations.idiomatic: The soil of Xu and Yu has many paddy fields, yet the people devote themselves solely to dry cultivation; orders should be sent to the two garrisons to put the old embankments back in service, jointly repair and establish them, and also assign reclamation so that the work is completed by next year.

sentences.zh: 凡諸州郡，皆令盡勤地利，勸導播殖，蠶桑麻紵，各盡其方，不得但奉行公文而已。」

translations.literal: In all commanderies and provinces, each is ordered to exhaust the land's advantage, encourage and guide planting and cultivation, and in sericulture, mulberry, hemp, and ramie each give full effort to its method—they must not merely carry out documents on paper."
translations.idiomatic: In every province and commandery, all are ordered to exhaust the land's advantage, encourage planting and cultivation, and give full effort to sericulture, mulberry, hemp, and ramie each in its season—they must not merely carry out documents on paper."

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，征西大將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季為征北大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，征北將軍、南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the eighth month, Yiji, Prince of Hengyang, Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Jing Province, was made Grand General Who Campaigns North, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Southern Xu Province; Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the eighth month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed Grand General Who Campaigns North, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Southern Xu Province; Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: [31]南兗州刺史廣陵王誕為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: [31] Dan, Prince of Guangling and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: [31] Prince of Guangling Dan, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，以大沮渠安周為征西將軍、涼州刺史，封河西王。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day of the ninth month, Juqu Anzhou was made Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province and was enfeoffed as Prince of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the ninth month, Juqu Anzhou was appointed Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province and was enfeoffed as Prince of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，以左軍將軍徐瓊為兗州刺史，大將軍參軍申恬為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jimao day of the tenth month in winter, Xu Qiong, General of the Left Army, was made Governor of Yan Province; Shen Tian, Senior Clerk of the Grand General, was made Governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the tenth month in winter, Xu Qiong, General of the Left Army, was appointed Governor of Yan Province; Shen Tian, Senior Clerk of the Grand General, was appointed Governor of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月辛卯朔，改用御史中丞何承天元嘉新曆。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, the first of the first month in spring of the twenty-second year, the Yuanjia new calendar of He Chengtian, Imperial Censor, was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the first of the first month in spring of the twenty-second year, the Yuanjia new calendar compiled by Imperial Censor He Chengtian was adopted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史武陵王駿改為雍州刺史，湘州刺史南平王鑠為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was changed to Governor of Yong Province; Shuo, Prince of Nanping and Governor of Xiang Province, was made Governor of Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Yong Province; Prince of Nanping Shuo, Governor of Xiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，以侍中王僧朗為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the second month, Wang Senglang, Attendant-in-Ordinary, was made Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the second month, Wang Senglang, Attendant-in-Ordinary, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，立第八皇子褘為東海王，第九皇子昶為義陽王。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, the eighth imperial son Hui was established as Prince of Donghai, and the ninth imperial son Chang as Prince of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, the eighth imperial son Hui was created Prince of Donghai, and the ninth imperial son Chang was created Prince of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 夏六月辛亥，以南豫州刺史南平王鑠為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the sixth month in summer, Shuo, Prince of Nanping and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was made Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the sixth month in summer, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，以尚書僕射孟顗為尚書左僕射，中護軍何尚之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Meng Kai, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; He Shangzhi, General of the Central Army, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Meng Kai, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; He Shangzhi, General of the Central Army, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 雍州刺史武陵王駿討緣沔蠻，移一萬四千餘口於京師。

translations.literal: Jun, Prince of Wuling and Governor of Yong Province, campaigned against the Man along the Han River and moved more than fourteen thousand households to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Yong Province, campaigned against the Man along the Han River and relocated more than fourteen thousand households to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，征北大將軍、南兗州刺史衡陽王義季改為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, Yiji, Prince of Hengyang, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was changed to Governor of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，[32]開酒禁。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the ninth month, [32] the prohibition on wine was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the ninth month, [32] the prohibition on wine was lifted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，起湖熟廢田千頃。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, a thousand qing of abandoned fields at Hushu were brought back into cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, a thousand qing of abandoned fields at Hushu were brought back into cultivation.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，太子詹事范曄謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day of the twelfth month, Fan Ye, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, plotted rebellion; he and his associates were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the twelfth month, Fan Ye, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, plotted rebellion; he and his associates were all executed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免大將軍彭城王義康為庶人。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng and Grand General, was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Grand General Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以前豫州刺史趙伯符為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, Zhao Bofu, former Governor of Yu Province, was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Zhao Bofu, former Governor of Yu Province, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月丁巳，以長沙內史陸徽為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the first month in spring of the twenty-third year, Lu Hui, Administrator of Changsha, was made Governor of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the first month in spring of the twenty-third year, Lu Hui, Administrator of Changsha, was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 庚申，尚書左僕射孟顗去職。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Meng Kai, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, left office.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Meng Kai, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, resigned his post.

sentences.zh: 遷漢川流民於沔次。

translations.literal: Displaced persons from Han-chuan were moved to the banks of the Mian.
translations.idiomatic: Displaced persons from Han-chuan were resettled along the Mian.

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker 33 in the source text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 33 in the source text.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，以左衞將軍劉義賓為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the second month, Liu Yibin, General of the Left Guards, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province.
