translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the second month, Liu Yibin, General of the Left Guards, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 三月，索虜寇兗、豫，青、冀刺史申恬破之。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Suolu raided Yan and Yu; Shen Tian, Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Suolu raided Yan and Yu; Shen Tian, Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day of the fourth month in summer, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the fourth month in summer, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, the first of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the first of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 交州刺史檀和之伐林邑國，剋之。

translations.literal: Tan Hezhi, Governor of Jiao Province, attacked the state of Lin-yi and conquered it.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Hezhi, Governor of Jiao Province, attacked Lin-yi and conquered it.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，以散騎常侍杜坦為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Du Tan, Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary, was made Governor of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Du Tan, Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary, was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，揭陽赭賊攻建安郡，燔燒城府。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the eighth month, bandits of Jieyang in red paint attacked Jian'an Commandery and burned the prefectural and commandery offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the eighth month, the red-painted bandits of Jieyang attacked Jian'an Commandery and burned the prefectural and commandery offices.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，車駕幸國子學，策試諸生，答問凡五十九人。

translations.literal: On the jimao day of the ninth month, the imperial carriage visited the Imperial Academy, examined the students by questioning, and fifty-nine answered.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the ninth month, the Emperor visited the Imperial Academy, examined the students by questioning, and fifty-nine answered.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，詔曰：「庠序興立累載，冑子肄業有成。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the tenth month in winter, an edict said: "The schools have stood for many years, and the sons of the nobility have completed their studies.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the tenth month in winter, an edict said: "The schools have stood for many years, and the sons of the nobility have completed their studies.

sentences.zh: 近親策試，覩濟濟之美，緬想洙、泗，永懷在昔。

translations.literal: Having recently examined them in person, I beheld their flourishing array and, looking far back to Zhu and Si, forever cherish what is past.
translations.idiomatic: Having recently examined them in person, I beheld their flourishing assembly and, looking far back to Zhu and Si, forever cherish what is past.

sentences.zh: 諸生答問，多可採覽。

translations.literal: The students' answers to the questions may largely be adopted for review.
translations.idiomatic: The students' answers in the examination may largely be adopted for review.

sentences.zh: 教授之官，並宜沾賚。

translations.literal: The instructors should all receive rewards."
translations.idiomatic: Their instructors should all receive rewards."

sentences.zh: 」賜帛各有差。

translations.literal: Silk was granted, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Silk was distributed, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，以龍驤司馬蕭景憲為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Jingxian, Staff Officer of the Dragon-charger, was made Governor of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Jingxian, Staff Officer of the Dragon-charger, was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大有年。

translations.literal: That year, the harvest was abundant.
translations.idiomatic: That year brought a great harvest.

sentences.zh: 築北堤，立玄武湖，築景陽山於華林園。

translations.literal: The northern embankment was built, Xuanwu Lake was established, and Jingyang Hill was constructed in Hualin Park.
translations.idiomatic: The northern embankment was built, Xuanwu Lake was established, and Jingyang Hill was constructed in Hualin Park.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月甲戌，大赦天下，文武賜位一等。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the first month in spring of the twenty-fourth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the first month in spring of the twenty-fourth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 繫囚降宥，諸逋負寬減各有差。

translations.literal: Imprisoned convicts received reduced sentences; overdue obligations were leniently reduced, each according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: Imprisoned convicts received reduced sentences; overdue obligations were leniently reduced, each according to measure.

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 蠲建康、秣陵二縣今年田租之半。

translations.literal: This year's land tax in Jiankang and Moling counties was remitted by half.
translations.idiomatic: This year's land tax in Jiankang and Moling counties was remitted by half.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，護軍將軍趙伯符遷職。

translations.literal: On the renshen day of the third month, Zhao Bofu, General Who Protects the Army, was transferred from his post.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the third month, Zhao Bofu, General Who Protects the Army, was transferred from his post.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲戌，青州刺史杜坦加冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the fifth month in summer, Du Tan, Governor of Qing Province, was additionally made Governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the fifth month in summer, Du Tan, Governor of Qing Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 六月，京邑疫癘，丙戌，使郡縣及營署部司，普加履行，給以醫藥。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, plague struck the capital; on the bingxu day, the commanderies and counties and the departmental offices of the garrisons were all ordered to tour and inspect, supplying medicine.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, plague struck the capital; on the bingxu day, the commanderies and counties and the departmental offices of the garrisons were ordered to conduct inspections throughout and supply medicine.

sentences.zh: 是月，以貨貴，制大錢一當兩。

translations.literal: That month, because goods were costly, large coins were instituted with a value of two.
translations.idiomatic: That month, because goods had grown costly, large coins were instituted with a value of two.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，以林邑所獲金銀寶物，班賚各有差。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the seventh month in autumn, the gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Lin-yi were distributed as gifts, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the seventh month in autumn, the gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Lin-yi were distributed as gifts, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，征北大將軍、徐州刺史衡陽王義季薨。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day of the eighth month, Yiji, Prince of Hengyang, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Xu Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the eighth month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Xu Province, died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以南兗州刺史劉義賓為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, Liu Yibin, Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made Governor of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Liu Yibin, Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed Governor of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，以中領軍沈演之為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the ninth month, Shen Yanzhi, Director of the Central Army, was made General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the ninth month, Shen Yanzhi, Director of the Central Army, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以太子詹事徐湛之為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，豫章胡誕世反，殺太守桓隆之，前交州刺史檀和之南還至豫章，因討平之。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the tenth month in winter, Hu Danshi of Yuzhang rebelled and killed Administrator Huan Longzhi; Tan Hezhi, former Governor of Jiao Province, was returning south and reached Yuzhang, whereupon he suppressed and pacified the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the tenth month in winter, Hu Danshi of Yuzhang rebelled and killed Administrator Huan Longzhi; Tan Hezhi, former Governor of Jiao Province, was returning south and reached Yuzhang, whereupon he suppressed the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以建平王宏為中護軍。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Hong, Prince of Jianping, was made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Prince of Jianping Hong was appointed General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，立第十皇子渾為汝陰王。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day of the eleventh month, the tenth imperial son Hun was established as Prince of Ruyin.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the eleventh month, the tenth imperial son Hun was created Prince of Ruyin.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月戊辰，詔曰：「比者冰雪經旬，薪粒貴踊，貧弊之室，多有窘罄。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the first month in spring of the twenty-fifth year, an edict said: "Of late ice and snow have lasted many days; fuel and grain have grown costly, and poor and distressed households are many in their straits.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the first month in spring of the twenty-fifth year, an edict said: "Of late ice and snow have lasted many days; fuel and grain have grown costly, and poor and distressed households are many in their straits.

sentences.zh: 可檢行京邑二縣及營署，賜以柴米。」

translations.literal: The two counties of the capital and the garrisons may be inspected and supplied with firewood and grain."
translations.idiomatic: The two counties of the capital and the garrisons should be inspected and supplied with firewood and grain."

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，詔曰：「安不忘虞，經世之所同；

translations.literal: On the gengyin day of the second month, an edict said: "In security one does not forget peril—this all ages hold in common;
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the second month, an edict said: "In security one does not forget peril—this all ages hold in common;

sentences.zh: 治兵教戰，有國之恒典。

translations.literal: to train the army and teach warfare is the constant statute of a state.
translations.idiomatic: to train the army and teach warfare is the constant statute of a state.

sentences.zh: 故服訓明恥，然後少長知禁。

translations.literal: Therefore when instruction is received and shame is understood, then young and old alike know prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore when instruction is received and shame is understood, then young and old alike know prohibition.

sentences.zh: 頃戎政雖修，而號令未審。

translations.literal: Of late military affairs have indeed been cultivated, yet orders and proclamations have not been made clear.
translations.idiomatic: Of late military affairs have indeed been cultivated, yet orders and proclamations have not been made clear.

sentences.zh: 今宣武場始成，便可剋日大習眾軍。

translations.literal: Now that the Xuanyong training ground has just been completed, on a set day the mass of troops may be drilled on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the Xuanyong training ground has just been completed, on a set day the mass of troops may be drilled on a great scale.

sentences.zh: 當因校獵，肄武講事。」

translations.literal: This should be carried out by means of a hunting review, to practice arms and discuss affairs."
translations.idiomatic: This should be carried out by means of a hunting review, to practice arms and discuss affairs."

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉，大蒐于宣武場。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the intercalary month, a great hunt was held at the Xuanyong training ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the intercalary month, a great hunt was held at the Xuanyong training ground.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，車駕校獵。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day of the third month, the imperial carriage conducted a hunting review.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the third month, the Emperor conducted a hunting review.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，新作閶闔、廣莫二門，改先廣莫門曰承明，開陽曰津陽。

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the fourth month in summer, the new Changhe and Guangmo gates were built; the former Guangmo gate was renamed Chenming, and Kaiyang was renamed Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the fourth month in summer, the new Changhe and Guangmo gates were built; the former Guangmo gate was renamed Chenming, and Kaiyang was renamed Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以撫軍將軍、雍州刺史武陵王駿為安北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yong Province, was made General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yong Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以右衞將軍蕭思話為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, Xiao Sihua, General of the Right Guards, was made Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Xiao Sihua, General of the Right Guards, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，罷大錢當兩。

translations.literal: On the jimao day of the fifth month, the large coin valued at two was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the fifth month, the large coin valued at two was abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，零陵王司馬元瑜薨。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the sixth month, Sima Yuanyu, Senior Clerk of the Prince of Lingling, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the sixth month, Sima Yuanyu, Senior Clerk of the Prince of Lingling, died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，安北將軍、徐州刺史武陵王駿加兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province, was additionally made Governor of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車騎將軍、荊州刺史南譙王義宣進位司空。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province, was promoted to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，左光祿大夫王敬弘薨。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the seventh month in autumn, Wang Jinghong, Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the seventh month in autumn, Wang Jinghong, Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, died.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以撫軍參軍劉秀之為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the eighth month, Liu Xiuzhi, Consulting Colonel of the Pacification Army, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the eighth month, Liu Xiuzhi, Consulting Colonel of the Pacification Army, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲子，立第十一皇子彧為淮陽王。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, the eleventh imperial son Yu was established as Prince of Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the eleventh imperial son Yu was created Prince of Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以尚書右僕射何尚之為尚書左僕射，領軍將軍沈演之遷職，吳興太守劉遵考為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the ninth month, He Shangzhi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Shen Yanzhi, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred from his post; Liu Zunkao, Administrator of Wuxing, was made General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the ninth month, He Shangzhi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Shen Yanzhi, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred from his post; Liu Zunkao, Administrator of Wuxing, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the first month in spring of the twenty-sixth year, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the first month in spring of the twenty-sixth year, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，車駕陸道幸丹徒，謁京陵。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the second month, the imperial carriage traveled by land to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the second month, the Emperor traveled by land to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，[34]詔曰：「朕違北京，二十餘載，雖云密邇，瞻塗莫從。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the third month, [34] an edict said: "I have been away from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though it is said to lie close at hand, I have had no road by which to gaze upon the journey thither.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the third month, [34] an edict said: "For more than twenty years I have been kept from the northern capital; though men say it lies near at hand, I have had no road by which to look upon the journey home.

sentences.zh: 今因四表無塵，時和歲稔，復獲拜奉舊塋，展罔極之思，饗讌故老，申追遠之懷。

translations.literal: Now, because the four quarters are without dust and the seasons are harmonious and the harvest full, I have again been able to bow before the old tombs, unfold thoughts of boundless grief, feast the elders of former days, and express feelings of remembrance for the distant past.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the realm is at peace and the seasons are harmonious and the harvest abundant, I have again been able to worship at the ancestral tombs, express boundless grief, feast the elders of former days, and voice my longing for those gone before.

sentences.zh: 固以義兼於桑梓，情加於過沛，永言慷慨，感慰實深。

translations.literal: Thus in righteousness it joins with one's native place, and in feeling it exceeds even passing through Pei; speaking forever, I am deeply moved—my gratitude and consolation are indeed profound.
translations.idiomatic: Thus my duty to my homeland joins with my affection, and my feeling exceeds even the emotion of passing through Pei; speaking of it ever stirs me, and my gratitude and consolation are profound indeed.

sentences.zh: 宜聿宣仁惠，覃被率土。

translations.literal: It is fitting forthwith to proclaim benevolence and favor and spread them over all the land.
translations.idiomatic: Let benevolence and favor be proclaimed at once and spread throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 其大赦天下。

translations.literal: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty is proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 復丹徒縣僑舊今歲租布之半。

translations.literal: Restore half of this year's land tax and cloth levy for the migrant households of Dantu county.
translations.idiomatic: Half of this year's land tax and cloth levy for Dantu county's migrant households is remitted.

sentences.zh: 行所經縣，蠲田租之半。

translations.literal: In the counties through which the journey passes, remit half the land tax.
translations.idiomatic: In the counties along the route, half the land tax is remitted.

sentences.zh: 二千石官長並勤勞王務，宜有沾錫。

translations.literal: The prefects and magistrates at the two-thousand-bushel rank who have all diligently served the royal affairs should receive a share of favor.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects and magistrates who have diligently served the royal cause should receive rewards.

sentences.zh: 登城三戰及大將戰亡墜沒之家，老病單弱者，普加贍卹。

translations.literal: Households of the three battles at Dengcheng and of great generals who died or fell in battle, and the aged, sick, and solitary weak, are all to receive general relief and support.
translations.idiomatic: Households from the three battles at Dengcheng and families of great generals killed or lost in battle, together with the aged, sick, and solitary weak, are to receive general relief.

sentences.zh: 遣使巡行百姓，問所疾苦。

translations.literal: Send envoys to tour among the common people and inquire into their hardships.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys are sent to tour the districts and inquire into the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 孤老、鰥寡、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: The solitary aged, widowers and widows, and those among the six infirmities who cannot support themselves are each to be granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: The solitary aged, widowers and widows, and those of the six infirmities unable to support themselves are each granted five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 」遣使祭晉故司空忠肅公何無忌之墓。

translations.literal: " Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tomb of the former Jin Minister of Works, Duke of Loyal Solemnity He Wuji.
translations.idiomatic: " Envoys were dispatched to offer sacrifice at the tomb of the former Jin Minister of Works, Duke of Loyal Solemnity He Wuji.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，申南北沛下邳三郡復。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, the tax remissions of the three commanderies of Northern and Southern Pei and Xiapi were proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, tax remissions were proclaimed for the three commanderies of Northern Pei, Southern Pei, and Xiapi.

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「京口肇祥自古，著符近代，衿帶江山，表裏華甸，經塗四達，利盡淮、海，城邑高明，土風淳壹，苞總形勝，實唯名都。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "Jingkou has been a place of auspicious origin since antiquity and has borne omens in recent times; girdled by rivers and mountains, within and without it is the flower of the central domain; highways reach it in all four directions and its profit extends to the Huai and sea; its cities and towns are lofty and bright, its local customs pure and uniform; gathering all strategic advantages, it is truly a famous capital.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said: "Jingkou has been auspicious since antiquity and has borne omens in recent times; girdled by rivers and mountains, it is the heart of the central domain; highways reach it on every side and its profit extends to the Huai and the sea; its cities are lofty and its customs pure; gathering every strategic advantage, it is truly a famous capital.

sentences.zh: 故能光宅靈心，克昌帝業。

translations.literal: Therefore it could illuminate the imperial mind and bring the imperial enterprise to flourishing success.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore it could illuminate the imperial mind and bring the imperial enterprise to success.

sentences.zh: 頃年岳牧遷回，軍民徙散，廛里廬宇，不逮往日。

translations.literal: In recent years the provincial governors have shifted back and forth and soldiers and civilians have been scattered and displaced; the lanes and dwellings no longer match former days.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the provincial governors have shifted back and forth and soldiers and civilians have been scattered; the lanes and dwellings no longer match former days.

sentences.zh: 皇基舊鄉，地兼蕃重，宜令殷阜，式崇形望。

translations.literal: The old homeland of the imperial foundation, its territory weighty among the domains, should be made prosperous and its outward dignity exalted.
translations.idiomatic: As the old homeland of the imperial foundation, its territory weighty among the domains, it should be made prosperous and its outward dignity exalted.

sentences.zh: 可募諸州樂移者數千家，給以田宅，并蠲復。」

translations.literal: Several thousand households willing to relocate from the various provinces may be recruited, given fields and dwellings, and granted remissions."
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand households willing to relocate from the various provinces may be recruited, given fields and dwellings, and granted remissions."

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，詔曰：「吾生於此城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the bingyin day, an edict said: "I was born in this city.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the fifth month, an edict said: "I was born in this city.

sentences.zh: 及盧循肆亂，害流茲境。

translations.literal: When Lu Xun wreaked havoc, harm flowed through this region.
translations.idiomatic: When Lu Xun wreaked havoc, harm flowed through this region.

sentences.zh: 先帝以桑梓根本，實同休戚，復以蒙稚，猥同艱難，情義繾綣，夷險兼備，舊物遺蹤，猶存心目。

translations.literal: The late Emperor, because this was the root of the mulberry homeland and truly shared weal and woe, and because I was still young and undeservedly shared the hardships, our bond of righteousness was close and we endured peril together; traces of old things still remain before my eyes.
translations.idiomatic: The late Emperor, because this was the root of the mulberry homeland and truly shared weal and woe, and because I was still young and undeservedly shared the hardships, our bond of righteousness was close and we endured peril together; traces of old things still remain before my eyes.

sentences.zh: 歲月不居，逝踰三紀，時人故老，與運零落。

translations.literal: The years do not stay; more than three decades have passed, and the people and elders of that time have fallen away with fate.
translations.idiomatic: The years do not stay; more than three decades have passed, and the people and elders of that time have fallen away with fate.

sentences.zh: 眷惟既往，倍深感歎。

translations.literal: Looking back on what is past, my feeling of deep sighing is doubled.
translations.idiomatic: Looking back on what is past, my feeling of deep sighing is doubled.

sentences.zh: 可搜訪于時士庶文武今尚存者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Search out civil and military gentlemen of that time, common and official, who still survive today, and report all their names.
translations.idiomatic: Search out civil and military gentlemen of that time, common and official, who still survive today, and report all their names.

sentences.zh: 人身已亡而子孫見在，優量賜賚之。

translations.literal: If the person himself has died but sons and grandsons survive, favor them generously with gifts."
translations.idiomatic: If the person himself has died but sons and grandsons survive, favor them generously with gifts."

sentences.zh: 」車駕水路發丹徒，壬午，至京師。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage set out from Dantu by water route; on the renwu day it reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor set out from Dantu by water; on the renwu day he reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，婆皇國，壬辰，婆達國，並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, the state of Bapo; on the renchen day, the state of Bada—both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the state of Bapo; on the renchen day, the state of Bada—both sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，以江州刺史廬陵王紹為南徐州刺史，廣陵王誕為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on the xinwei day, Shao, Prince of Luling and Governor of Jiang Province, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province; Dan, Prince of Guangling, was made Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province; Prince of Guangling Dan was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以中護軍建平王宏為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Hong, Prince of Pingling and General Who Protects the Army, was made Governor of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Prince of Pingling Hong, General Who Protects the Army, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以南豐王朗為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, Lang, Prince of Nanfeng, was made Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，廣陵王誕改封隨郡王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Dan, Prince of Guangling, was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Suixiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was reassigned as Prince of Suixiang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以中軍將軍、揚州刺史始興王濬為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南徐兗二州刺史，南徐州刺史廬陵王紹為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Jun, Prince of Shixing and General of the Central Army and Governor of Yang Province, was made General Who Campaigns North, with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Shao, Prince of Luling and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made Governor of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General of the Central Army and Governor of Yang Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns North with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Dukes and Governor of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed Governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月辛未，制交、寧二州假板郡縣，俸祿聽依臺除。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the first month in spring of the twenty-seventh year, Jiao and Ning provinces were ordered to grant acting commission seals to commandery and county officials; salaries were to follow central appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the first month in spring of the twenty-seventh year, Jiao and Ning provinces were ordered to grant acting commission seals to commandery and county officials; salaries were to follow central appointment.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, the state of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the state of Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，右將軍、豫州刺史南平王鑠進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, Shuo, Prince of Nanping, General of the Right, and Governor of Yu Province, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Prince of Nanping Shuo, General of the Right and Governor of Yu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，[35]索虜寇汝南諸郡，陳南頓二郡太守鄭琨、汝陽潁川二郡太守郭道隱委守走。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, [35] the Suolu raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, [35] the Suolu raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.

sentences.zh: 索虜攻懸瓠城，行汝南郡事陳憲拒之。

translations.literal: The Suolu attacked Xuancheng; Chen Xian, Acting Administrator of Runan, resisted them.
translations.idiomatic: The Suolu attacked Xuancheng; Chen Xian, Acting Administrator of Runan, resisted them.

sentences.zh: 以軍興減百官俸三分之一。

translations.literal: Because of military exigency, the salaries of the hundred officials were reduced by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: Because of military exigency, the salaries of the hundred officials were reduced by one-third.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，淮南太守諸葛闡求減俸祿同內百官，於是州及郡縣丞尉並悉同減。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Kan, Administrator of Huainan, requested that salaries be reduced in the same manner as the inner court officials; thereupon the prefectures and commanderies, and the assistant magistrates and commandants, were all likewise reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Kan, Administrator of Huainan, requested that salaries be reduced in the same manner as the inner court officials; thereupon prefectures and commanderies, and assistant magistrates and commandants, were all likewise reduced.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷國子學。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, the National University was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the National University was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以新除吏部尚書蕭思話為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing, was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，安北將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on the renzi day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General Who Garrisons the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on the renzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General Who Garrisons the Army.

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker 36 in the source text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 36 in the source text.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，侍中蕭斌為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the dingyou day, Xiao Bin, Palace Attendant, was made Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on the dingyou day, Xiao Bin, Palace Attendant, was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，遣寧朔將軍王玄謨北伐。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on the gengwu day, Wang Xuanmo, General Who Tranquilizes the North, was dispatched on the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn on the gengwu day, Wang Xuanmo, General Who Tranquilizes the North, was dispatched on the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 太尉江夏王義恭出次彭城，總統諸軍。

translations.literal: Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and Grand General, went out and encamped at Pengcheng, commanding all the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand General, advanced and encamped at Pengcheng to command all the armies.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，索虜碻磝戍委城走。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the Suolu garrison at Qiuyao abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the Suolu garrison at Qiuyao abandoned the city and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 冬閏月癸亥，玄謨攻滑臺，不克，為虜所敗，退還碻磝。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month of winter on the guihai day, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but could not take it; he was defeated by the barbarians and withdrew to Qiuyao.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month of winter on the guihai day, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but could not take it; he was defeated by the Suolu and withdrew to Qiuyao.

sentences.zh: 辛未，雍州刺史隨王誕遣軍攻弘農城，克之。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Dan, Prince of Suixiang and Governor of Yong Province, sent troops to attack Hongnong city and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Prince of Suixiang Dan, Governor of Yong Province, sent troops to attack Hongnong and captured it.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，又克關城。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, they again captured Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, they again captured Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，索虜陷鄒山，魯、陽平二郡太守崔邪利沒。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Suolu captured Zou Mountain; Cui Xieli, Administrator of Lu and Yangping, was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Suolu captured Zou Mountain; Cui Xieli, Administrator of Lu and Yangping, was captured.

sentences.zh: 甲午，隨王誕所遣軍又攻陝城，克之。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, the troops sent by Prince of Suixiang Dan again attacked Shan city and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the troops sent by Prince of Suixiang Dan again attacked Shan city and captured it.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，左軍將軍劉康祖於壽陽尉武戍與虜戰敗見殺。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left, was killed in battle with the barbarians at the Wei Wu garrison in Shouyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left, was killed in battle with the Suolu at the Wei Wu garrison in Shouyang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，內外纂嚴。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, martial law was imposed throughout the court and realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, martial law was imposed throughout the court and realm.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，冗從僕射胡崇之、太子積弩將軍臧澄之、建威將軍毛熙祚於盱眙與虜戰敗，並見殺。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant-in-Ordinary, Zang Cheng, General of Crossbowmen for the Heir Apparent, and Mao Xizuo, General Who Establishes Might, were killed in battle with the barbarians at Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant-in-Ordinary, Zang Cheng, General of Crossbowmen for the Heir Apparent, and Mao Xizuo, General Who Establishes Might, were killed in battle with the Suolu at Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 庚午，虜偽主率大眾至瓜步。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, the Suolu pretender ruler led a great host to Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the Suolu pretender ruler led a great host to Guabu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, heightened security was ordered throughout the court and realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, heightened security was ordered throughout the court and realm.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月丙戌朔，以寇逼不朝會。

translations.literal: On the bingxu new moon of the first month in spring of the twenty-eighth year, because of the enemy threat there was no court assembly.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the first month in spring of the twenty-eighth year, because of the enemy threat there was no court assembly.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，索虜自瓜步退走。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, the Suolu withdrew from Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the Suolu withdrew from Guabu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，攻圍盱眙城。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi city.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 是月，寧朔將軍王玄謨自碻磝退還歷下。

translations.literal: That month, Wang Xuanmo, General Who Tranquilizes the North, withdrew from Qiuyao and returned to Lixia.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wang Xuanmo, General Who Tranquilizes the North, withdrew from Qiuyao and returned to Lixia.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，索虜自盱眙奔走。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the second month, the Suolu fled in disorder from Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the second month, the Suolu fled in disorder from Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔曰：「玁狁孔熾，難及數州，眷言念之，鑒寐興悼。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun are fiercely rampant, bringing hardship to several provinces; speaking of them with concern, I grieve whether waking or sleeping.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun are fiercely rampant, bringing hardship to several provinces; speaking of them with concern, I grieve whether waking or sleeping.

sentences.zh: 凶羯痍挫，迸跡遠奔，彫傷之民，宜時振理。

translations.literal: The fierce Jie are wounded and broken; they flee in haste to distant places; the people they have maimed should be restored in timely fashion.
translations.idiomatic: The fierce Jie are wounded and broken; they flee in haste to distant places; the people they have maimed should be restored in timely fashion.

sentences.zh: 凡遭寇賊郡縣，令還復居業，封屍掩骼，賑贍饑流。

translations.literal: In all commanderies and counties that suffered raids by bandits, order them to return and resume their occupations; bury exposed corpses and cover bare bones; relieve and support the hungry and displaced.
translations.idiomatic: In all commanderies and counties that suffered raids, order the people to return and resume their occupations; bury exposed corpses and cover bare bones; relieve and support the hungry and displaced.

sentences.zh: 東作方始，務盡勸課。

translations.literal: The spring plowing has just begun; strive to the utmost in encouraging cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Spring plowing has just begun; strive to the utmost in encouraging cultivation.

sentences.zh: 貸給之宜，事從優厚。

translations.literal: As to provisions for loans and grants, matters should follow a generous standard.
translations.idiomatic: As to provisions for loans and grants, matters should follow a generous standard.

sentences.zh: 其流寓江、淮者，並聽即屬，并蠲復稅調。

translations.literal: Those who have drifted to the Jiang and Huai regions are all to be allowed to register where they are and granted remission of taxes and levies."
translations.idiomatic: Those who have drifted to the Jiang and Huai regions are all to be allowed to register where they are and granted remission of taxes and levies."

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，太尉、領司徒江夏王義恭降為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, Grand General, and concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to General of Agile Cavalry with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand General and concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to General of Agile Cavalry with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，鎮軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號北中郎將。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Garrisons the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General of the Northern Center.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Garrisons the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General of the Northern Center.

sentences.zh: 壬午，車駕幸瓜步，是日解嚴。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, the imperial carriage visited Guabu; that day martial law was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the Emperor visited Guabu; that day martial law was lifted.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the third month, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，征北將軍始興王濬解南兗州。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Jun, Prince of Shixing and General Who Campaigns North, was relieved of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General Who Campaigns North, was relieved of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以輔國將軍臧質為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Zhi, General Who Assists the State, was made Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Zhi, General Who Assists the State, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徐州刺史武陵王駿為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, Jun, Prince of Wuling and Governor of Xu Province, was made Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xu Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，護軍將軍蕭思話為撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Protects the Army, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，婆達國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on the guiyou day, the state of Bada sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on the guiyou day, the state of Bada sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 索虜偽寧南將軍魯爽、中書郎魯秀歸順。

translations.literal: Shuang, the Suolu pretender General Who Pacifies the South, and Xiu, Secretariat Gentleman of the Suolu, submitted in allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Shuang, the Suolu pretender General Who Pacifies the South, and Xiu, Secretariat Gentleman of the Suolu, submitted in allegiance.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以爽為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Shuang was made Inspector of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Shuang was appointed Inspector of Si Province.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，亡命司馬順則自號齊王，據梁鄒城。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，婆皇國，戊戌，河南王，並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, the state of Bapo; on the wuxu day, the King of Henan—all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the state of Bapo; on the wuxu day, the King of Henan—all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: [37]己巳，驃騎將軍江夏王義恭領南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: [37] On the jisi day, Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and General of Agile Cavalry, took up the governorship of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: [37] On the jisi day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General of Agile Cavalry, took up the governorship of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以尚書左僕射何尚之為尚書令，太子詹事徐湛之為尚書僕射、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, He Shangzhi, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Xu Zhanzhi, Director of the Household of the Heir Apparent, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, He Shangzhi, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing; Xu Zhanzhi, Director of the Household of the Heir Apparent, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以後將軍隨王誕為安南將軍、廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, Dan, Prince of Suixiang and General of the Rear, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Prince of Suixiang Dan, General of the Rear, was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，以北中郎將武陵王駿為江州刺史，以振武將軍、秦郡太守劉興祖為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renxu day of the sixth month, Jun, Prince of Wuling and General of the Northern Center, was made Governor of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, General Who Quells Martial Fervor and Administrator of Qin commandery, was made Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the sixth month, Prince of Wuling Jun, General of the Northern Center, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, General Who Quells Martial Fervor and Administrator of Qin commandery, was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，安東將軍倭王倭濟進號安東大將軍。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day of the seventh month in autumn, the Eastern barbarian king of Wa, Wajin, was advanced in title to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the seventh month in autumn, the Eastern barbarian king of Wa, Wajin, was advanced to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，梁鄒平，斬司馬順則。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the tenth month in winter, the state of Koguryo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the tenth month in winter, the state of Koguryo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，曲赦二兗、徐、豫、青、冀六州。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the six provinces of the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the six provinces of Eastern Yan, Western Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 是冬，徙彭城流民於瓜步，淮西流民於姑孰，合萬許家。

translations.literal: That winter, displaced persons from Pengcheng were moved to Guabu and those from west of the Huai to Gudu—together about ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, displaced persons from Pengcheng were moved to Guabu and those from west of the Huai to Gudu—together about ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月甲午，詔曰：「經寇六州，居業未立，[38]仍值災澇，饑困荐臻。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the first month in spring of the twenty-ninth year, an edict said: "The six provinces have suffered raids; livelihoods are not yet established, [38] and they have again met with flood disaster; hunger and distress have come one upon another.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the first month in spring of the twenty-ninth year, an edict said: "The six provinces have suffered raids; livelihoods are not yet established, [38] and they have again met with flood disaster; hunger and distress have come one upon another.

sentences.zh: 可速符諸鎮，優量救卹。

translations.literal: Quickly send orders to the various garrisons to relieve and support them generously.
translations.idiomatic: Quickly send orders to the various garrisons to relieve and support them generously.

sentences.zh: 今農事行興，務盡地利。

translations.literal: Now the agricultural work is rising; strive to the utmost in using the land's profit.
translations.idiomatic: Now the agricultural work is rising; strive to the utmost in using the land's profit.

sentences.zh: 若須田種，隨宜給之。」

translations.literal: If seed for fields is needed, grant it as appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: If seed for fields is needed, grant it as appropriate."

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，虜帥拓跋燾死。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day of the second month, the Suolu ruler Tuoba Tao died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the second month, the Suolu ruler Tuoba Tao died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，[39]立第十二皇子休仁為建安王。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was established as Prince of Jian'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was created Prince of Jian'an.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on the wuwu day, the state of Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on the wuwu day, the state of Heluodan sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 以驃騎參軍張永為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong, Staff Officer of the General of Agile Cavalry, was made Inspector of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong, Staff Officer of the General of Agile Cavalry, was appointed Inspector of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，罷湘州并荊州。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 以始興、臨賀、始安三郡屬廣州，丙申，詔曰：「惡稔身滅，戎醜常數，虐虜窮凶，著於自昔。

translations.literal: The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were placed under Guang Province; on the bingchen day, an edict said: "When wickedness is full, the body perishes; the barbarian foes follow a constant pattern; the cruel barbarian's extremity of evil has been manifest since old.
translations.idiomatic: The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were placed under Guang Province; on the bingchen day, an edict said: "When wickedness is full, the body perishes; the barbarian foes follow a constant pattern; the cruel barbarian's extremity of evil has been manifest since old.

sentences.zh: 未勞資斧，已伏天誅，子孫相殘，親黨離貳，關、洛偽帥，並懷內款，河朔遺民，注誠請効。

translations.literal: Without troubling the battle-axe, he has already suffered Heaven's execution; sons and grandsons harm one another and kin and partisans are divided; the pretender chiefs of Tong and Luo all harbor inward submission, and the remnant people north of the Yellow River pour forth loyalty and request to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Without troubling the battle-axe, he has already suffered Heaven's execution; sons and grandsons harm one another and kin and partisans are divided; the pretender chiefs of Tong and Luo all harbor inward submission, and the remnant people north of the Yellow River pour forth loyalty and request to serve.

sentences.zh: 拯溺蕩穢，今其會也。

translations.literal: To rescue the drowning and sweep away filth—now is the time.
translations.idiomatic: To rescue the drowning and sweep away filth—now is the time.

sentences.zh: 可符驃騎、司空二府，各部分所統，東西應接。

translations.literal: Send orders to the two offices of the General of Agile Cavalry and the Minister of Works; each is to connect east and west according to what he commands.
translations.idiomatic: Send orders to the two offices of the General of Agile Cavalry and the Minister of Works; each is to connect east and west according to what he commands.

sentences.zh: 歸義建績者，隨勞酬獎。

translations.literal: Those who submit in allegiance and establish merit are to be rewarded according to their labor."
translations.idiomatic: Those who submit in allegiance and establish merit are to be rewarded according to their labor."

sentences.zh: 」是月，京邑雨水。

translations.literal: That month, the capital region suffered rain flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the capital region suffered rain flooding.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，遣部司巡行，賜樵米，給船。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the sixth month, the Department of State Affairs was sent on tour to grant firewood and grain and provide boats.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the sixth month, the Department of State Affairs was sent on tour to grant firewood and grain and provide boats.

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍蕭思話率眾北伐。

translations.literal: Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army, led troops on the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army, led troops on the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 以征北從事中郎劉瑀為益州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Yu, Consulting Colonel of the Army Who Campaigns North, was made Inspector of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, Consulting Colonel of the Army Who Campaigns North, was appointed Inspector of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，汝陰王渾改封武昌王，淮陽王彧改封湘東王。

translations.literal: On the renchen day of the seventh month in autumn, Hun, Prince of Ruyin, was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Wuchang; Yu, Prince of Huaiyang, was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Xiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the seventh month in autumn, Prince of Ruyin Hun was reassigned as Prince of Wuchang; Prince of Huaiyang Yu was reassigned as Prince of Xiangdong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，省大司農、太子僕、廷尉監官。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, the supervisory posts of the Grand Minister of Agriculture, Director of the Household of the Heir Apparent, and Director of Justice were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the supervisory posts of the Grand Minister of Agriculture, Director of the Household of the Heir Apparent, and Director of Justice were abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，蕭思話攻碻磝，不拔，退還。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day of the eighth month, Xiao Sihua attacked Qiuyao but could not take it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the eighth month, Xiao Sihua attacked Qiuyao but could not take it and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，以平西將軍吐谷渾拾寅為安西將軍、秦河二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day of the ninth month, Murong Shibin of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Qin and He provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the ninth month, Murong Shibin of the Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Qin and He provinces.

sentences.zh: 己丑，撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史蕭思話加冀州刺史，兗州如故。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was additionally made Inspector of Ji Province; Yan Province remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was additionally appointed Inspector of Ji Province; Yan Province remained as before.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，司州刺史魯爽攻虎牢不拔，退還。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the tenth month in winter, Shuang, Inspector of Si Province, attacked Hulao but could not take it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the tenth month in winter, Shuang, Inspector of Si Province, attacked Hulao but could not take it and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，揚州刺史廬陵王紹薨。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the eleventh month, Shao, Prince of Luling and Governor of Yang Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the eleventh month, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Yang Province, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，以驃騎將軍、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為大將軍、南徐州刺史，錄尚書事如故。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the twelfth month, Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, General of Agile Cavalry, and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made Grand General and Governor of Southern Xu Province, with his duties as Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the twelfth month, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Grand General and Governor of Southern Xu Province, while retaining his post as Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 三十年春正月戊寅，以司空、荊州刺史南譙王義宣為司徒、中軍將軍、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day of the first month in spring of the thirtieth year, Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao, Minister of Works and Governor of Jing Province, was made Minister over the Masses, General of the Central Army, and Governor of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the first month in spring of the thirtieth year, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, Minister of Works and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed Minister over the Masses, General of the Central Army, and Governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 以南兗州并南徐州。

translations.literal: Southern Yan Province was merged into Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Yan Province was merged into Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以領軍將軍劉遵考為平西將軍、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, Liu Zunkao, General Who Garrisons the Army, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Liu Zunkao, General Who Garrisons the Army, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以征北將軍、南徐州刺史始興王濬為衛將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, Jun, Prince of Shixing, General Who Campaigns North, and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made General of the Guard and Governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed General of the Guard and Governor of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 戊子，江州刺史武陵王駿統眾軍伐西陽蠻。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, commanded the mass of armies in campaigning against the Xiyang Man.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun commanded the mass of armies in campaigning against the Xiyang Man.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以豫州刺史南平王鑠為撫軍將軍、領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, Shuo, Prince of Nanping and Inspector of Yu Province, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and General Who Garrisons the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Inspector of Yu Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and General Who Garrisons the Army.

sentences.zh: 青、徐州饑，二月壬子，遣運部賑卹。

translations.literal: Qing and Xu provinces suffered famine; on the renzi day of the second month, the Transport Department was sent to relieve and support.
translations.idiomatic: Qing and Xu provinces suffered famine; on the renzi day of the second month, the Transport Department was sent to relieve and support.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上崩于含章殿。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, the Emperor died in the Hall of Containing Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the Emperor died in the Hall of Containing Splendor.

sentences.zh: 時年四十七。

translations.literal: He was forty-seven years old.
translations.idiomatic: He was forty-seven years old.

sentences.zh: 諡曰景皇帝，廟曰中宗。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Emperor Jing; his temple name was Zhongzong.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Emperor Jing; his temple name was Zhongzong.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，葬長寧陵。

translations.literal: On the guisi day of the third month, he was buried at Changning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the third month, he was buried at Changning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 世祖踐阼，追改諡及廟號。

translations.literal: When Shizu ascended the throne, he retroactively changed the posthumous title and temple name.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizu ascended the throne, he retroactively changed the posthumous title and temple name.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：太祖幼年特秀，顧無保傅之嚴，而天授和敏之姿，自禀君人之德。

translations.literal: The historian says: The Founder in his youth was uniquely gifted; though he had no strict tutors and protectors, Heaven bestowed a harmonious and keen nature, and he himself possessed the virtue of a ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: The Founder in his youth was uniquely gifted; though he had no strict tutors and protectors, Heaven bestowed a harmonious and keen nature, and he himself possessed the virtue of a ruler.

sentences.zh: 及正位南面，歷年長久，綱維備舉，條禁明密，罰有恒科，爵無濫品。

translations.literal: When he took the throne facing south, his years were long; the framework of government was fully established, regulations and prohibitions clear and close, punishments had fixed statutes, and ranks of nobility had no indiscriminate grants.
translations.idiomatic: When he took the throne facing south, his years were long; the framework of government was fully established, regulations and prohibitions clear and close, punishments had fixed statutes, and ranks of nobility had no indiscriminate grants.

sentences.zh: 故能內清外晏，四海謐如也。

translations.literal: Therefore within was pure and without was tranquil; the four seas were at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore within was pure and without was tranquil; the four seas were at peace.

sentences.zh: 昔漢氏東京常稱建武、永平故事，自茲厥後，亦每以元嘉為言，斯固盛矣。

translations.literal: Formerly the Eastern Han often spoke of the precedents of Jianwu and Yongping; after that age as well, men regularly took the Yuanjia era as their standard—this was truly a flourishing age.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Eastern Han often spoke of the precedents of Jianwu and Yongping; after that age as well, men regularly took the Yuanjia era as their standard—this was truly a flourishing age.

sentences.zh: 授將遣帥，乖分閫之命，才謝光武，而遙制兵略，至於攻日戰時，莫不仰聽成旨。

translations.literal: When appointing generals and dispatching commanders, he went against the division of authority at the frontier gates; his talent fell short of Emperor Guangwu's, yet he remotely controlled military strategy—when it came to the day of battle, none failed to listen upward for the completed decree.
translations.idiomatic: When appointing generals and dispatching commanders, he went against the division of authority at the frontier gates; his talent fell short of Emperor Guangwu's, yet he remotely controlled military strategy—when it came to the day of battle, none failed to listen upward for the completed decree.

sentences.zh: 雖覆師喪旅，將非韓、白，而延寇慼境，抑此之由。

translations.literal: Though armies were overturned and hosts lost, the generals were no Han Xin or Bai Qi; yet prolonging the enemy and bringing grievance to the borders—this too was the reason.
translations.idiomatic: Though armies were overturned and hosts lost, the generals were no Han Xin or Bai Qi; yet prolonging the enemy and bringing grievance to the borders—this too was the reason.

sentences.zh: 及至言漏衾衽，難結商豎，雖禍生非慮，蓋亦有以而然也。

translations.literal: When it reached the point that words leaked from the pillow and mat and trouble bound the merchant of old, though disaster arose beyond forethought, there was also cause for it to be so.
translations.idiomatic: When it reached the point that words leaked from the pillow and mat and trouble bound the merchant of old, though disaster arose beyond forethought, there was also cause for it to be so.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！

translations.literal: Alas, how mournful!
translations.idiomatic: Alas, how mournful!

translations.idiomatic: Collation Notes

translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage reached the capital city — Sun Ao's Examination of the Song History says: "It should read capital metropolis.

sentences.zh: 京城則京口矣。

translations.idiomatic: Comment: The Comprehensive Mirror reads Jiankang.

translations.literal: In the Song History, capital city often refers to Jingkou city; here it refers to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song History, capital city often refers to Jingkou city; here it refers to Jiankang.

translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb — all editions alike omit the two characters xinwei; supplemented according to the Southern History, Veritable Records of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror.

translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Jian'an Pan Sheng was guilty and executed — Pan Sheng in all editions reads Pan Cheng; emended according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Xu Xianzhi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯 各本並作「己卯」，據局本及南史改。

translations.literal: On the yimao day — all editions read jimao; emended according to the Bureau edition and Southern History.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day — all editions read jimao; emended according to the Bureau edition and Southern History.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁酉朔，十九日乙卯，無己卯。

translations.literal: Comment: That month the new moon was on dingyou day; the nineteenth day was yimao—there was no jimao.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: That month the new moon was on dingyou day; the nineteenth day was yimao—there was no jimao.

sentences.zh: 領平北將軍南徐州刺史 各本並脫「南」字，按彭城王義康傳、建康實錄、通鑑並作南徐州刺史，今據補。

translations.literal: Concurrently General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Xu Province — all editions alike omit the character "south"; according to the biography of Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Veritable Records of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror, all read Governor of Southern Xu Province; now supplemented accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Concurrently General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Xu Province — all editions alike omit the character south; according to the biography of Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Veritable Records of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror, all read Governor of Southern Xu Province; now supplemented accordingly.

translations.idiomatic: Former Campaigning against Barbarians Staff Officer Yin Chong was made Inspector of Si Province — all editions alike omit the character Yin; according to the Suolu Monograph, at the time Yin Chong was Inspector of Si Province, as the Comprehensive Mirror also has it.

translations.literal: Now supplemented accordingly.

translations.literal: Grand General Who Campaigns South Tan Daoji defeated the Suolu at Dongping Shouzhang — all editions alike omit the character "ping."
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Who Campaigns South Tan Daoji defeated the Suolu at Dongping Shouzhang — all editions alike omit the character ping.

sentences.zh: 據檀道濟傳補。

translations.literal: Supplemented according to the biography of Tan Daoji.
translations.idiomatic: Supplemented according to the biography of Tan Daoji.

sentences.zh: 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「按檀道濟傳作東平壽張，此『東』下脫『平』字。」

translations.literal: Hong Yixuan, Examination of Discrepancies in the Various Histories, says: "According to the biography of Tan Daoji it reads Dongping Shouzhang; here below 'east' the character 'ping' is omitted."
translations.idiomatic: Hong Yixuan, Examination of Discrepancies in the Various Histories, says: "According to the biography of Tan Daoji it reads Dongping Shouzhang; here below east the character ping is omitted."

sentences.zh: 苟不深存務本 各本並脫「苟」字，據元龜一九八補。

translations.literal: If one does not deeply preserve the root of affairs — all editions alike omit the character "if"; supplemented according to Yuance 198.
translations.idiomatic: If one does not deeply preserve the root of affairs — all editions alike omit the character if; supplemented according to Yuance 198.

sentences.zh: 以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍 「慕容延」本書吐谷渾傳作「慕延」。

translations.literal: Murong Yan of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the East — "Murong Yan" in this book's Tuyuhun monograph reads "Mu Yan."
translations.idiomatic: Murong Yan of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the East — Murong Yan in this book's Tuyuhun monograph reads Mu Yan.

sentences.zh: 魏書作「慕利延」。

translations.literal: The Wei History reads "Muli Yan."
translations.idiomatic: The Wei History reads Muli Yan.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍 各本並脫「谷」字，據前後文例補。

translations.literal: Huifa of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Garrisons the Army — all editions alike omit the character "gu" in Tuyuhun; supplemented according to the pattern of the text before and after.
translations.idiomatic: Huifa of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Garrisons the Army — all editions alike omit the character gu in Tuyuhun; supplemented according to the pattern of the text before and after.

sentences.zh: 「輝伐」魏書作「緯代」。

translations.literal: "Huifa" in the Wei History reads "Weidai."
translations.idiomatic: Huifa in the Wei History reads Weidai.

sentences.zh: 壬申河南國河西王遣使獻方物 「河西王」各本作「西河王」，據少帝紀景平元年及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。

translations.literal: On the renshen day the state of Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys presenting local products — "King of Hexi" in all editions reads "King of Xihe"; emended according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor, year 1 of Jingping, and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day the state of Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys presenting local products — King of Hexi in all editions reads King of Xihe; emended according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor, year 1 of Jingping, and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.

sentences.zh: 亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山 三朝本作「泰山」，弘治本、北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「秦梁」。

translations.literal: The outlaw Ma Daxuan and his band of several hundred men raided Taishan — the Three Dynasties edition reads "Taishan"; the Hongzhi, Northern Supervisory, Mao, Hall, and Bureau editions read "Qin and Liang."
translations.idiomatic: The outlaw Ma Daxuan and his band of several hundred men raided Taishan — the Three Dynasties edition reads Taishan; the Hongzhi, Northern Supervisory, Mao, Hall, and Bureau editions read Qin and Liang.

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on the yiyou day — according to the calendar that month the new moon was on dinghai day; there was no yiyou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on the yiyou day — according to the calendar that month the new moon was on dinghai day; there was no yiyou.

sentences.zh: 二十三日己酉，「乙酉」或是「己酉」之譌。

translations.literal: The twenty-third day was jiyou; "yiyou" is perhaps a corruption of "jiyou."
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-third day was jiyou; yiyou is perhaps a corruption of jiyou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉 「辛酉」各本並作「乙酉」，據南史改。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on the xinyou day — "xinyou" in all editions reads "yiyou"; emended according to the Southern History.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn on the xinyou day — xinyou in all editions reads yiyou; emended according to the Southern History.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚戌朔，初六日辛酉，無「乙酉」。

translations.literal: Comment: That month the new moon was on gengxu day; the sixth day was xinyou—there was no "yiyou."
translations.idiomatic: Comment: That month the new moon was on gengxu day; the sixth day was xinyou—there was no yiyou.

sentences.zh: 於益州立南晉壽南新巴北巴西三郡 各本並作「於益州立南晉壽新巴西三郡」。

translations.literal: In Yi Province the three commanderies of Southern Jinsou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi were established — all editions read "In Yi Province the three commanderies of Southern Jinsou, Xinba, and Baxi were established."
translations.idiomatic: In Yi Province the three commanderies of Southern Jinsou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi were established — all editions read In Yi Province the three commanderies of Southern Jinsou, Xinba, and Baxi were established.

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「據州郡志，是南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。

translations.literal: Sun Ao, Examination of the Song History, says: "According to the Monograph of Provinces and Commanderies, these are the three commanderies of Southern Jinsou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi."
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ao, Examination of the Song History, says: "According to the Monograph of Provinces and Commanderies, these are the three commanderies of Southern Jinsou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi."
