translations.literal: Comment: Sun's view is correct; now emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: Sun's view is correct; now emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 又此條上云「壬申」，下云「乙亥」。

translations.literal: Again, in this entry above it says "renshen" and below "yihai."
translations.idiomatic: Again, in this entry above it says renshen and below yihai.

sentences.zh: 按是月丙戌朔，無壬申，亦無乙亥。

translations.literal: Comment: According to the calendar that month the new moon was on bingxu day; there was neither renshen nor yihai.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: According to the calendar that month the new moon was on bingxu day; there was neither renshen nor yihai.

sentences.zh: 以步兵校尉劉真道為梁南秦二州刺史 「劉真道」各本並作「劉道真」。

translations.literal: Liu Zhendao, Colonel of Foot Soldiers, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces — "Liu Zhendao" in all editions reads "Liu Daozhen."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhendao, Colonel of Foot Soldiers, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces — Liu Zhendao in all editions reads Liu Daozhen.

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「當作劉真道，見劉懷肅傳，下十八年亦作劉真道。

translations.literal: Zhang Senkai's Collation Notes say: "It should read Liu Zhendao, as in the biography of Liu Huaisu; below in year eighteen it also reads Liu Zhendao."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Senkai's Collation Notes say: "It should read Liu Zhendao, as in the biography of Liu Huaisu; below in year eighteen it also reads Liu Zhendao."

sentences.zh: 」按張說是，今改正。

translations.literal: Comment: Zhang's view is correct; now emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: Zhang's view is correct; now emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 河南國河西王訶羅單國並遣使獻方物 「河西王」各本並作「西河王」，據少帝紀及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。

translations.literal: The state of Henan and the King of Hexi and the state of Heluodan all sent envoys presenting local products — "King of Hexi" in all editions reads "King of Xihe"; emended according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Henan and the King of Hexi and the state of Heluodan all sent envoys presenting local products — King of Hexi in all editions reads King of Xihe; emended according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.

sentences.zh: 燕王弘遣使獻方物 「弘」各本並作「年」，據晉書載記改。

translations.literal: The Yan king Hong sent envoys presenting local products — "Hong" in all editions reads "nian"; emended according to the Jin History annals.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan king Hong sent envoys presenting local products — Hong in all editions reads nian; emended according to the Jin History annals.

sentences.zh: 今年有不收處 「年」各本並作「半」，據元龜四八九改。

translations.literal: Places where this year there was no harvest — "year" in all editions reads "half"; emended according to Yuance 489.
translations.idiomatic: Places where this year there was no harvest — year in all editions reads half; emended according to Yuance 489.

sentences.zh: 以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射 「王球」各本並作「王琳」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: Wang Qiu, Special Grandee, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing — "Wang Qiu" in all editions reads "Wang Lin"; emended according to the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qiu, Special Grandee, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing — Wang Qiu in all editions reads Wang Lin; emended according to the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「王球作王琳，是傳寫之譌。」

translations.literal: Hong Yixuan, Examination of Discrepancies in the Various Histories, says: "Wang Qiu written as Wang Lin is a corruption of transmission."
translations.idiomatic: Hong Yixuan, Examination of Discrepancies in the Various Histories, says: "Wang Qiu written as Wang Lin is a corruption of transmission."

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午 「壬午」各本作「壬申」。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer on the renwu day — "renwu" in all editions reads "renshen."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer on the renwu day — renwu in all editions reads renshen.

sentences.zh: 局本作「壬午」。

translations.literal: The Bureau edition reads "renwu."
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau edition reads renwu.

sentences.zh: 按是月壬午朔，無壬申。

translations.literal: Comment: That month the new moon was on renwu day; there was no renshen.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: That month the new moon was on renwu day; there was no renshen.

sentences.zh: 今從局本。

translations.literal: Now follow the Bureau edition.
translations.idiomatic: Now follow the Bureau edition.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射王球卒 「球」各本並作「琳」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Qiu died — "Qiu" in all editions reads "Lin"; emended according to the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Qiu died — Qiu in all editions reads Lin; emended according to the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 是月 各本並作十二月。

translations.literal: That month — all editions read twelfth month.
translations.idiomatic: That month — all editions read twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 按上已有十月，十一月，十二月，不當重出十二月。

translations.literal: Comment: Above there are already the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth months; the twelfth month should not appear again.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: Above there are already the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth months; the twelfth month should not appear again.

sentences.zh: 今改作是月。

translations.literal: Now emended to read that month.
translations.idiomatic: Now emended to read that month.

sentences.zh: 盛王聖世 「聖」各本並作「祖」，據元龜一九四改。

translations.literal: In a flourishing age and a sage reign — "sage" in all editions reads "ancestor"; emended according to Yuance 194.
translations.idiomatic: In a flourishing age and a sage reign — sage in all editions reads ancestor; emended according to Yuance 194.

sentences.zh: 始奉礿祠 「礿」各本並作「初」，據元龜二０七改。

translations.literal: First performing the yue sacrifice — "yue" in all editions reads "initial"; emended according to Yuance 207.
translations.idiomatic: First performing the yue sacrifice — yue in all editions reads initial; emended according to Yuance 207.

sentences.zh: 庚申 各本同。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day — all editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day — all editions agree.

sentences.zh: 按是月壬申朔，初三日甲戌，是月無庚申。

translations.literal: Comment: That month the new moon was on renshen day; the third day was jiaxu—there was no gengshen in that month.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: That month the new moon was on renshen day; the third day was jiaxu—there was no gengshen in that month.

sentences.zh: 下有甲申，為十三日。

translations.literal: Below there is jiashen, the thirteenth day.
translations.idiomatic: Below there is jiashen, the thirteenth day.

sentences.zh: 甲戌、甲申之間有庚辰。

translations.literal: Between jiaxu and jiashen there is gengchen.
translations.idiomatic: Between jiaxu and jiashen there is gengchen.

sentences.zh: 庚申疑庚辰之譌。

translations.literal: Gengshen is suspected to be a corruption of gengchen.
translations.idiomatic: Gengshen is suspected to be a corruption of gengchen.

sentences.zh: 南徐南豫州揚州之浙江西 各本同。

translations.literal: Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the districts of Yang Province west of the Zhe River — all editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the districts of Yang Province west of the Zhe River — all editions agree.

sentences.zh: 南史於「南徐」下有「南兗」二字。

translations.literal: The Southern History after "Southern Xu" has the two characters "Southern Yan."
translations.idiomatic: The Southern History after Southern Xu has the two characters Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍 「駿」各本作「贊」，三朝本作「諱」。

translations.literal: Governor of Southern Yu Province Jun, Prince of Wuling, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army — "Jun" in all editions reads "Zan"; the Three Dynasties edition reads "tabooed name."
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Southern Yu Province Jun, Prince of Wuling, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army — Jun in all editions reads Zan; the Three Dynasties edition reads tabooed name.

sentences.zh: 按時武陵王駿，即後之孝武帝。

translations.literal: Comment: At the time it was Prince of Wuling Jun—later Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: At the time it was Prince of Wuling Jun—later Emperor Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 贊為宋明帝第九子，後亦封武陵王，時尚未生。

translations.literal: Zan was the ninth son of Emperor Ming; he too was later enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling, but at the time had not yet been born.
translations.idiomatic: Zan was the ninth son of Emperor Ming; he too was later enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling, but at the time had not yet been born.

sentences.zh: 今改作「駿」。

translations.literal: Now emended to read "Jun."
translations.idiomatic: Now emended to read Jun.

sentences.zh: 征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍荊州刺史 「南徐州刺史」各本並脫「南」字，據義宣傳補。

translations.literal: Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province — "Governor of Southern Xu Province" in all editions omits the character "south"; supplemented according to the biography of Yixuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province — Governor of Southern Xu Province in all editions omits the character south; supplemented according to the biography of Yixuan.

sentences.zh: 九月己未 「己未」各本並作「乙未」，局本作「己未」。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the jiwei day — "jiwei" in all editions reads "yimao"; the Bureau edition reads "jiwei."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on the jiwei day — jiwei in all editions reads yimao; the Bureau edition reads jiwei.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁巳朔，初三日己未，無乙未。

translations.literal: Comment: That month the new moon was on dingsi day; the third day was jiwei—there was no yimao.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: That month the new moon was on dingsi day; the third day was jiwei—there was no yimao.

sentences.zh: 今從局本。

translations.literal: Now follow the Bureau edition.
translations.idiomatic: Now follow the Bureau edition.

sentences.zh: 遷漢川流民於沔次 「漢川」各本作「漢州」，按時無「漢州」，據元龜四八六改。

translations.literal: Relocation of Han River refugees to the banks of the Mian. All editions read "Han Province" for "Han River"; at the time there was no "Han Province"—now emended per Yuan gui 486.
translations.idiomatic: Relocation of Han River refugees to the Mian shore. All editions read Han Province for Han River; no such province existed at the time—emended per Yuan gui 486.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳 下有乙丑。

translations.literal: Third month, dingsi day; below this there is yichou.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingsi day; yichou follows below.

sentences.zh: 各本同。

translations.literal: All editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: All editions agree.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁卯朔，無丁巳，亦無乙丑。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month had new moon on dingmao—there was neither dingsi nor yichou.
translations.idiomatic: That month's new moon fell on dingmao—neither dingsi nor yichou is possible.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申朔，二十二日丁巳，三十日乙丑。

translations.literal: Fourth month new moon on bingshen; twenty-second day dingsi, thirtieth day yichou.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: new moon on bingshen; dingsi on the twenty-second day, yichou on the thirtieth.

sentences.zh: 辛亥 各本並作「辛巳」。

translations.literal: Xinhai. All editions read xinsi.
translations.idiomatic: Xinhai [day]. All editions read xinsi.

sentences.zh: 通鑑考異云：「按長曆，二月壬辰朔，十日辛丑，二十日辛亥。

translations.literal: Zizhi tongjian Collation says: "According to the long calendar, second month new moon on renchen; tenth day xinchou, twentieth day xinhai.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhi tongjian Collation notes: "Per the long calendar, second-month new moon on renchen; xinchou on the tenth day, xinhai on the twentieth.

sentences.zh: 辛巳當作辛亥。

translations.literal: Xinsi should read xinhai.
translations.idiomatic: Xinsi should read xinhai.

sentences.zh: 」今據改。

translations.literal: " Now emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 安北將軍徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍 「駿」宋本作「諱」。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the North Jun, Prince of Wuling, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, demoted to General Who Pacifies the Army. "Jun" in the Song edition reads tabooed character.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan, demoted to General Who Pacifies the Army. The Song edition has a taboo placeholder for Jun.

sentences.zh: 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本作「贊」，今據孝武帝紀訂正。

translations.literal: The Sanzhao edition, Northern Directorate edition, Mao edition, and Hall edition read "Zan"; now corrected per the Basic Annals of Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: The Sanzhao, Northern Directorate, Mao, and Hall editions read Zan; corrected per Emperor Xiaowu's annals.

sentences.zh: 說見本卷校勘記第三十條。

translations.literal: See collation note 30 in this juan.
translations.idiomatic: See collation note 30 in this scroll.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉亡命司馬順則自號齊王據梁鄒城丁巳婆皇國戊戌河南王並遣使獻方物 按是年五月甲申朔，初二日乙酉，十五日戊戌，無丁巳。

translations.literal: Fifth month yiyou: the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou; dingsi: Pohuang kingdom; wuxu: Prince of Henan; all sent tribute. According to the calendar, that year fifth month new moon was on jiashen; second day yiyou, fifteenth day wuxu—there was no dingsi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the fifth month, outlaw Sima Shunze declared himself King of Qi and held Liangzou; entries for dingsi (Pohuang), wuxu (Prince of Henan), and tribute missions follow. That year's fifth month began on jiashen—yiyou was day 2, wuxu day 15; dingsi cannot occur.

sentences.zh: 丁巳日支當有誤。

translations.literal: The dingsi day entry is surely in error.
translations.idiomatic: The dingsi entry must be corrupt.

sentences.zh: 居業未立 「立」各本並作「能」，據元龜一九五改。

translations.literal: "Could not yet establish their livelihoods": all editions read "could not yet" for "establish"; now emended per Yuan gui 195.
translations.idiomatic: "Households had not yet established livelihoods": all editions read neng (able) for li (establish)—emended per Yuan gui 195.

sentences.zh: 戊午 各本並作「庚午」，據南史改。

translations.literal: Wuwu. All editions read gengwu; now changed per the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Wuwu day. All editions read gengwu; emended per Nanshi.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚戌朔，無庚午。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month had new moon on gengxu—there was no gengwu.
translations.idiomatic: That month opened on gengxu—gengwu is impossible.

sentences.zh: 初九日戊午。

translations.literal: The ninth day was wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: Wuwu fell on the ninth day.
